name: Joker Spirit
description: When possessing another character, grants possession stat bonuses based on the possession slot. If the host is using a bow or left handbag in the left hand, that slot is treated like right-hand possession.

name: Expansion Arm
description: Deals physical damage and may clear the target's default buffs after a successful hit. The buff-clear chance is 70% normally and 30% in PvP.

name: Feint
description: Checks the target for delay cancel effects, Gunmaster, Parry, Counterattack, or Gladiator. If one is found, Feint removes it and has a 65% chance to apply Stiffness to the target. If no valid state is found, Feint applies Stiffness to the caster instead.

name: Quick Slash Combo 3
description: Final Swordsman combo skill. If the character has the later Kensei passive, the skill gains extra damage and opens additional higher-tier combo routes. In PvP, only the Kensei bonus portion is reduced to 50% of its normal value.

name: Iron Stomach
description: Improves food item recovery and shortens food item use time. The bonus also applies while riding, using the rider's Iron Stomach level.

name: Meditation

description: Leaps and slashes downward with the user's body weight. It deals higher damage to Insect monsters. If the character has the later Kensei passive, the skill gains extra damage and sets up Maximize Spirit Sword as the next combo skill; in PvP, only the Kensei bonus portion is reduced to 50%.

name: Kihop

name: War Cry

name: Battle Encouragement
description: Can only be used while possessing another character. Buffs the host's ATK and MATK using the possessor's own base ATK and MATK, including equipment stats. It cancels Critical Encouragement and Defense Encouragement on the same host.

name: Swallow Snatcher
description: Performs a precise slash suited to catching a quick bird. It deals higher damage to Bird monsters. If the character has the later Kensei passive, the skill gains extra damage and sets up Maximize Spirit Sword as the next combo skill; in PvP, only the Kensei bonus portion is reduced to 50%.

name: Beast Jawbreaker
description: Slashes upward as if breaking a beast's jaw. It deals higher damage to Animal monsters. If the character has the later Kensei passive, the skill gains extra damage and sets up Maximize Spirit Sword as the next combo skill; in PvP, only the Kensei bonus portion is reduced to 50%.

description: Releases a short-range shockwave that deals Blow physical damage.

name: Cold-Blooded Berserk
name_jp: バーサーク・コントロール
description: Gives a chance to stay controllable when Berserker triggers. The control chance is increased by the character's total INT. While riding, the passive is applied to the riding partner and uses the rider's total INT for the control check.

name: Double Draw
description: Focuses power into the blade and performs two physical draw attacks against enemies in front of the user. The attack area covers the first two rows in the user's facing direction.

name: Specter Sword
description: Unleashes repeated sword strikes on one target. If the character has the later Kensei passive, the skill gains extra damage and sets up Zillion Blade as the next combo skill; in PvP, only the Kensei bonus portion is reduced to 50%.

name: Double Slash

description: Fires the learned Iai, Iai 2, and Iai 3 stages in sequence. Any stage the character has not learned does not activate.

name: Reverse Edge

name: Torso Slasher
name_jp: ストレートスラッシュ
description: Deals physical damage at the listed rate. On a damaging hit against a player or riding target, has a chance to cancel possession in this skill's matching slot and unequip the matching equipment slot when possible.

name_jp: オーナメントスラッシュ
description: Deals physical damage at the listed rate. On a damaging hit against a player or riding target, has a chance to cancel possession in this skill's matching slot and unequip the matching equipment slot when possible.

description: Randomly attacks the target's possession slots three times. Attacks against slots without the required Slash skill do not activate. Against monsters, this becomes a three-hit slash.

With Martial Art Techniques Lv 3, the damage rate becomes 130/142/154/166/178% instead of the base rate.

name: Agitate

name: Brandish

name: Indomitable Fighting Spirit
description: When the user's HP falls to a level-based threshold after taking damage, has a 40% chance to restore HP, MP, and SP. Each threshold can trigger once while the passive state remains active.

name: Ekville
description: Grants the Ekville buff for the listed duration. No connected stat, damage, resistance, or combat interaction is currently attached to this buff, so it behaves as a visible timed buff only.

description: Toggles a stance that converts current Additive DEF into ATK, capped at 300. While active, the same flat value is subtracted from Additive DEF and added to both minimum ATK and maximum ATK.

name: Large Wheels
description: Hits enemies in a 5x5 area around the user, knocks damaged targets back 3 cells, and may apply Slow for 5 seconds. If the user has Gravity , Slow chance gains +4% per Gravity Lv. If the user has Tornado Attack, Large Wheels gains extra damage.

name: Pressure
description: Places a 5x5 pressure field that slows valid enemies while they stay inside. Up to 3 Pressure fields can be active; outside PvP, the limit is counted separately by skill level, while in PvP all Pressure fields count together toward the same 3-field limit.

name: Survive
description: When taking damage at low HP, has a chance to trigger an area counterattack around the character and knock damaged targets back 3 cells. Each HP threshold can trigger once while the state remains active.

name: Remove Weapon
description: Deals physical damage and then checks for an additional effect only if the hit damages the target. Against player targets, it can unequip right-hand equipment and non-shield left-hand equipment, canceling possession from those slots when present, then applies VIT down. Against non-player targets, it can lower ATK and MATK instead; boss targets receive the shorter debuff duration.

name: God Speed Slash
description: Deals physical damage, moves the user to the tile just before the target, and may Stun damaged non-boss targets. PvP halves the final damage rate. If Kensei is learned, God Speed Slash gains +50% damage per Kensei Lv and opens combo routes to Brandish, Zillion Blade, and Quick Slash Combo 1-3.

name: Kensei
description: Enhances sword combo routes and adds bonus damage to specific slash skills. The Kensei bonus for Quick Slash combos, behead-style skills, Omnislash , Brandish , and Specter Sword is halved in PvP; God Speed Slash applies its PvP reduction after its Kensei bonus is added.

name: Defense Encouragement
name_jp: ディフェンスアシスト
description: Can only be used while possessing another character. While active on the host, part of the damage dealt to that host is redirected to the possessor who cast this skill. Defense Encouragement cancels Battle Encouragement and Critical Encouragement on the same target.

name: Knights Pledge
description: Protects characters possessing the caster: when a possessor inside the protected host would take damage, the host takes that damage instead. Cannot be used in Knight Training maps.

name: Knights Wrath

name: Divine Spear
description: Deals thrust physical damage. Damage is much higher against Undead targets.

name: Shield Pressure
description: May apply Stiffness to both the caster and the target. Boss monsters are immune to the Stiffness effect.

name: Valkyrie Spear
description: Deals physical damage along a straight path to the selected ground point. Learning Flying Spear increases the damage rate by +10% per Flying Spear level.

name: Sacrifice
description: Revives the target, but the caster becomes incapacitated. Cannot be used while another character is possessing the caster.

name: Master Provoke
description: Forces enemies in a 5x5 area around the caster to strongly target the caster.

name: Spear Cyclone
description: Performs three delayed physical hits against enemies in a straight line up to 4 cells in front of the caster.

name: Blessing Seal
description: Attempts to prevent the target from recovering HP, MP, and SP for 4 seconds. Boss monsters are immune.

name: Increase Fairy Property Damage
name_jp: 精霊・マリオネットダメージ上昇
description: Increases damage dealt to Fairy/Element-type monsters.

name: Dark Weapon
description: Adds Dark element ATK to the target's weapon for 50 seconds. If the target has Shadow Worshipper , Dark Weapon gains additional Dark ATK and may also add Dark element DEF.

name: Dark Tide
name_jp: ダークワールウィンド
description: Deals Dark physical damage to one target.

name: Necro Resurrection
name_jp: ネクロリザレクション
description: Gives a chance to automatically revive after being defeated. A successful Necro Resurrection revives the character with HP and applies Undead for 30 seconds.

name: Blade of Pursuit
description: Increases physical damage against targets that currently have an abnormal status.

name: Overwhelming Shadow
name_jp: ホーリーキャンセレーション

name: Dark Protection

name: Shadow Worshipper

description: Attempts to seal selected Holy, healing, and song/support skills, including Heal, Resurrection, Holy Bolt, Holy Ball, Holy Blade, Relax, Dead March, Oratorio, Salvation, and Gospel. Boss monsters are immune.

name: Bloody Brand

name: Shadow Mist

name: Life Steal
description: Deals physical damage and restores HP to the caster equal to 80% of the damage dealt.

name: Bloody Weapon

name: Black Flare
description: Deals Dark magical damage and may inflict Flare if the hit deals damage. Boss monsters are immune to the Flare effect. Flare ticks every 2 seconds for 20 seconds, dealing a percentage of Max HP with a 300 damage cap per tick, and cannot reduce the target below 1 HP by itself.

name: Price of Pain
description: Increases damage as HP gets lower.

name: Blood Absorption
description: Deals Neutral magical damage in a 3x3 area around the target and restores HP to the caster based on total damage dealt.

name: Flare Sting
description: Deals Dark physical damage and may trigger an additional Dark magical follow-up hit shortly after the attack.

name: Darkness of Night
name_jp: ダークネスオブナイト
description: Faces the selected ground cell and releases five Dark physical attack waves in front of the caster. Each wave checks a forward pattern up to 4 cells away in the caster's facing direction.

name: Piercing Mastery
name_jp: ピアッシングマスタリー
description: Improves ATK, S.HIT, and critical hit while using a sword, spear, or rapier.

name: DEF Communion
description: Consumes up to 100 SP and grants party members Additive DEF for 10 minutes. Normal scaling per SP is Lv1 0.98, Lv2 1.28, Lv3 1.58, Lv4 1.88, Lv5 2.18; in PvP the scaling is reduced to Lv1 0.36, Lv2 0.47, Lv3 0.58, Lv4 0.69, Lv5 0.81.

name: Guardian
description: Raises Additive DEF and Additive M.DEF by a percentage of the user's base values and blocks new Confusion, Frozen, Stun, Poison, Sleep, Slow, Stone, Silence, and Reborn while active. Guardian is a special ability buff, so movement, forced movement, knockback, and special-ability cancellation effects remove it.

name: Increase Hate
description: Increases monster aggro generated toward the character. This bonus does not apply while possessing another character.

name: Reflect Shield
description: Gives a chance to reflect eligible magic effects while a shield is equipped. In PvP, Reflect Shield can only trigger once every 3 seconds.

name: Aegis
description: Toggles the Aegis buff for the listed duration. No connected stat, damage reduction, resistance, or combat interaction is currently attached to this buff, so it behaves as a visible timed buff only.

name: Spirit Protect
description: Buffs valid allies in a 5x5 area around the user. While Spirit Protect is active, online possession removal effects that do not explicitly ignore Spirit Protect cannot forcibly cancel that character's possession.

name: Shield Impact
description: Hits enemies in a 3x3 area around the target, starts a 4 second reuse timer, and opens Light of Darkness as a combo route. Damaged non-boss targets have a 70% Stun chance for 2 seconds, reduced to 20% if they have Stun resistance. A separate 40% roll can apply level-based stat debuffs for 20 seconds.

name: Spiral Spear
description: Places a short-lived spear field at the target's position and opens Light of Darkness as a combo route. The field checks for enemies every 0.2 seconds for up to 2.5 seconds, dealing physical damage to valid targets. Damaged non-boss targets have a 15% chance to receive Stiffness for 1 second.

name: Strong Body
description: Buffs valid allies in a 7x7 area. The caster receives a larger DEF bonus than allies. Additive DEF is a flat value calculated from each target's base Additive DEF.

name: Blocking
description: While a shield remains equipped, incoming physical attacks against the user can be partially blocked. Blocking can also Stun the attacker. Shield Mastery adds +3% damage reduction per Shield Mastery Lv to the listed block reduction. In PvP, Blocking cannot be used while the caster is inside possession.

name: Fortress Circle
name_jp: フォートレスサークル
description: Creates a non-stackable wall field at the caster's position. On cast, nearby enemies are knocked back 4 cells and the caster becomes unable to move for the duration. While active, the field repeatedly deals 150% physical damage to enemies and heals allies inside the area. Incoming damage to the caster is reduced to 0 while Fortress Circle is active.

name: Light of Darkness
name_jp: ライトオブダークネス
description: Faces the selected ground point and strikes enemies in a 3-wide, 5-cell line in front of the user. Lv1 and Lv3 are Holy; Lv2 and Lv4 are Dark. PvP halves the damage rate. After use, it opens combo routes to Shield Impact and Spiral Spear .

name: Hiding
description: Turns the caster transparent. After about 5 seconds, it drains 1 SP per second and ends when SP reaches 0. It cannot be recast while already hidden.

name: Multi Throw
description: Throws several weapons at one target. The number consumed equals the number of hits. If Double Up is active, the damage rate is doubled and Double Up is consumed.

name: Throwing Mastery
name_jp: Throw Mastery / スローマスタリー
description: Improves minimum ATK and L.HIT while a throwing weapon or card is equipped.

name: Agility Up
name_jp: Avoid Burst / アヴォイド・バースト
description: Increases melee avoidance. Duration becomes shorter at higher levels.

name: Deception
description: Moves behind the target and briefly subtracts current DEF, DEF Add, MDEF, and MDEF Add from the caster for 1 second. It has a 70% chance to apply 3 seconds of Stiffness to the target.

name: Increase Dagger Accuracy
description: Increases S.HIT while using a dagger. Final bonus: base bonus + floor(base S.HIT * scaling rate)

name: Vital Strike
description: Temporarily increases critical chance for the attack. From Lv2 upward, a damaging hit may apply both Slow and Stun for 5 seconds.

name: Flying Roundhouse Kick
name_jp: Somersault Kick / サマーソルトキック
description: Deals damage and knocks the target back 3 cells. From Lv2 upward, damaging hits may apply 3 seconds of Stiffness to non-player, non-boss targets.

name: Dagger Delay Cancel
name_jp: Short Sword Delay Cancel / ショートソードディレイキャンセル
description: Removes existing delay cancel effects, then increases ASPD skill percentage.

name: Increase Critical
description: Increases critical chance for a short duration.

name: Unforeseen Onslaught
name_jp: Brandish / ブランディッシュ
description: Strikes the same target a random number of times. The server random call is exclusive of the upper bound, so Lv1-2 roll 2-3 hits and Lv3-5 roll 4-5 hits.

name: Multi Thrust
description: Performs repeated thrust attacks. If the equipped right-hand item is a throwing weapon or card, it must have enough quantity for all hits.

name: Claw Mastery
description: Improves minimum ATK and S.HIT while a claw is equipped.

name: Throwing Weapon Construction
description: Opens the Throwing Weapon Construction synthesis interface for the selected skill level.

name: Triple Claw
description: Adds a chance for normal attacks to strike three times while using a claw.

name: Increase Throwing Range
description: Increases attack range while using a throwing weapon or card.

name: Poison Needle
description: Consumes 1 Poison Needdle, deals physical damage, and may Poison the target for 10 seconds if the hit deals HP damage.

name: Intoxicative Defense
description: Consumes 1 Assassin Potion and increases DEF and Additive DEF. Without Increase Poison Chance , the caster may also be Poisoned for 7 seconds; with Increase Poison Chance learned, the buff lasts longer, gains extra DEF scaling, and the self-Poison chance becomes 0%.

name: Increase Throwing Accuracy
description: Improves L.HIT while using a throwing weapon or card.

name: Increase Poison Resistance
description: Adds Poison resistance, lowering the chance for Poison to be applied when the Poison resistance check is used.

name: Utsusemi Skin Shed
description: Marks a ground position for 5 seconds. When the caster is hit while the mark is active, the hit is negated, the caster blinks to the marked position, the buff ends, and this skill receives a 9 second cooldown.

name: Cloaking
description: Makes the caster transparent so enemies do not normally detect them. Cloaking cannot be cast while already cloaked, and it cannot be started when a valid enemy target is within the 7x7 area around the caster. After the first few seconds, the effect drains 1 SP every second and ends when SP reaches 0. Actions that cancel invisibility also remove Cloaking.

name: Critical Ambush
description: Deals physical damage; applies Stiffness.

name: Intoxicative Onslaught
description: Consumes 1 Assassin Potion, increases minimum and maximum ATK from the caster's base ATK, and may Poison the caster for 7 seconds. If Increase Poison Chance is learned, the buff lasts longer, gains extra ATK scaling, and the Poison chance becomes 0%.

name: Apply Poison
description: Consumes 1 Poison Potion. While active, the caster's normal attacks can Poison the target for 7 seconds.

name: Shadow Preparedness
description: Applies Def Down, Hit Critical Up.

name: Poison Mist
description: Consumes 1 Poison Potion and creates a 5x5 poison field at the caster's position. Every 0.5 seconds, the field damages valid enemies using the caster's attack element. Damage is fixed from the caster's Max HP, and the field ends when its duration expires, its hit limit is reached, or the caster dies.

name: Assassin Spirit
description: When possessing another character, grants possession stat bonuses based on the possession slot. If the host is using a bow or left handbag in the left hand, that slot is treated like right-hand possession.

name: Increase Critical Damage
name_jp: クリティカルダメージ上昇
description: Increases damage dealt by critical hits.

name: Intoxicative Berserk
description: Consumes 1 Assassin Potion, removes any existing delay-cancel buff, then increases ASPD. Without Increase Poison Chance , the caster may also be Poisoned for 7 seconds; with Increase Poison Chance learned, the ASPD buff lasts longer and the self-Poison chance is reduced.

name: Increase Poison Chance
description: Increases the chance for the character's Poison applications to succeed.

name: Mirror Image
description: Consumes Straw Dolls equal to the skill level and creates a temporary decoy or mirror at the selected position for 120 seconds. Cannot be used in Knight Training maps. If the caster already has the maximum number of mirror partners for that level, the oldest one is removed first.

name: Foot Walk
description:
Improves short-range and long-range avoidance based on the character's base avoidance. Final S.AVOID bonus: floor(base S.AVOID x scaling rate)

Final L.AVOID bonus: floor(base L.AVOID x scaling rate)

name: Surprise Attack
description: Deals physical damage; can knock the target back; applies Stun.

name: Increase Human Property Dodge
description: Improves the caster's avoid check against Human-type monsters. In PvP, the same check is applied in reverse against player attackers, reducing the caster's avoid check by the listed value.

name: Pistol Mastery
name_jp: ハンドガンマスタリー
description: Improves minimum ATK and L.HIT while using a gun. Final L.HIT bonus: flat bonus + floor(base L.HIT x scaling rate)

name: Tackle
description: Deals physical damage; can knock the target back.

name: Land Mine
description: Places a one-time trap at the caster's position for 60 seconds. It triggers on a non-flying enemy in its 3x3 trigger area, consumes Trap Tool durability, and deals physical damage that cannot miss.

name: Martial Arts Mastery
description: Lv 3 strengthens Barrage and Wild Dance . Lv 1-2 are learned normally but do not add a stat bonus or modify those skills in the current combat handling.

rows: Improves Barrage damage and adds +120% damage rate to each Wild Dance hit

name: Reckless Fire
description: Fires a random number of ranged physical shots at one target. Each shot has the listed damage rate and consumes one bullet; Dual Guns add one extra possible shot at every level.

name: Wing Breaker
description: Attempts to restrain a non-boss target. On success, the caster moves onto the target's position, the target is held by Stiffness, and the caster remains bound to the target until the effect ends.

name: Barrage
description: Hits the target 4 times with physical damage. If Martial Arts Mastery is learned at Lv 3, each hit uses the improved damage rate shown in the table.

header: Damage rate per hit with Martial Arts Mastery Lv 3

name: Skill Combination
description: A martial arts chain skill that activates the learned Leg Sweep, Somersault Kick, and Tackle skills in sequence.

name: Flash Grenade
name_jp: フラッシュグレネード
description: Consumes 1 Grenade and attempts to Stun valid enemies in a 3x3 area around the selected ground point. A stunned target is also forced out of Hiding.

name: Choking Gas
description: Places a trap at the caster's position for 30 seconds and consumes Choking Gas. When triggered by a non-flying enemy, it attempts to Silence valid non-boss enemies in a 5x5 area for 9 seconds.

name: Slide
description: Slides along a direct path up to 9 cells, damaging enemies touched by the path, then moves the caster to the destination. The total damage rate is split evenly among all targets hit.

name: Claymore Trap
description: Places a trap at the caster's position and consumes Trap Tool durability. After it triggers, it repeatedly checks every 1.5 seconds and deals physical damage that cannot miss to non-flying enemies in a 7x7 area.

name: Upper Cut
description: Deals physical damage; can knock the target back; applies Stun.

name: Cyclone
description: Deals physical damage; area: 3x3.

name: Detonate
description: Consumes Trap Tool durability, deals direct physical damage, then creates a delayed blast 1 second later. The delayed blast deals physical damage that cannot miss to non-flying enemies in a 3x3 area around the target.

name: Fatal Seal
description: Changes monster aggro; applies Unrecoverable.

name: Backup
description: Uses a Signal Bullet to call temporary Fellow's Command partners for 10 seconds. Lv 1 calls a protection partner, Lv 2 calls an attack partner, and Lv 3 calls both; the called partners inherit the caster's level and core combat stats.

name: Deadly Attack
description: Deals physical damage and may apply Stiffness if the hit deals HP damage. Boss monsters are immune to the Stiffness effect.

name: Rush Bomb
description: Consumes Trap Tool durability and starts a four-hit bomb sequence: 2 direct hits on the target, then 2 delayed area blasts that hit valid enemies in a 3x3 area around the target.

name: Wild Dance
description: Performs a chained physical combo: 3 single-target hits followed by a 3x3 finishing hit around the caster. If Martial Arts Mastery is learned at Lv 3, each hit gains +120% damage rate.

header: Damage rate per hit with Martial Arts Mastery Lv 3

name: Total Combat Mastery
name_jp: トータルコンバットマスタリー
description: Improves ATK, S.HIT, and critical hit while using an eligible weapon. The S.HIT bonus is applied for all eligible weapons.

name: AVOID Communion
description: Consumes up to 100 SP and grants party members S.AVOID and L.AVOID for 10 minutes. Normal scaling per SP is Lv1 0.70, Lv2 0.90, Lv3 1.10, Lv4 1.30, Lv5 1.50; in PvP the scaling is reduced to Lv1 0.42, Lv2 0.57, Lv3 0.74, Lv4 0.90, Lv5 1.05.

name: Eraser
description: Toggles a special combat buff. While active, the user's physical attacks reduce the target's DEF by 10 x Eraser Lv percentage points and reduce the target's Additive DEF by 10% x Eraser Lv for that damage calculation. Casting Eraser again cancels the buff, and the buff can also be removed by special-ability cancellation effects. It cannot be activated while riding.

name: Notio
description: When damaging a player character, also deals Neutral fixed damage to that target's online possessors.

name: Efficas
description: Builds a stacking damage bonus while active. Each physical or magical hit uses the current Efficas bonus, then raises the stored bonus by 5% for later hits until the cap is reached. The cap is 100%, or 50% while the caster is possessing another character. Recasting refreshes the duration and resets the stored bonus.

name: Revenge Attack
description: When a close-range attack misses, has a chance to immediately counterattack the target if it is not hiding. The counterattack receives a temporary S.HIT bonus.

name: Closeout
description: Grants a chance to fully avoid an incoming damaging attack after the attack has otherwise dealt damage. It does not trigger against attacks flagged as unable to miss. The skill also starts a separate 180 second reuse timer. In PvP, the duration is much shorter.

name: Devil
description: Hits the target 4 times and opens Setsuna as the next combo route. On damaging hits, Devil may apply different debuffs depending on the target type: player targets can lose AGI, DEX, and VIT, while monsters can lose S.AVOID, DEF, and S.HIT.

name: Merciless Shadow
description: Deals physical damage to enemies in a 3x3 area around the target. Damaged non-boss targets may receive Stiffness for 5 seconds. The skill starts a separate reuse timer of 5 + 5 x skill Lv seconds. If the user has Cloaking, Merciless Shadow also grants the Cloaking buff after use.

name: Shadow Stitch
description: Targets enemies in a 5x5 area around the selected ground point, cancels hiding, and may apply Stiffness. Non-player, non-boss targets also have a small instant-death chance. In PvP, Stiffness chance and duration use separate values.

name: Poison Master
description: Improves poison-related Eraser behavior through learned poison skills. Venom Blast checks Poison Mist and Detonate to increase its two damage hits, and checks Poison Master ownership to add Unrecoverable during its abnormal-status burst.

rows: First hit gains +200% + 30% x Poison Mist Lv damage rate
Second hit gains +500% + 30% x Detonate Lv damage rate
Enables Unrecoverable application during Venom Blast's status burst

name: Venom Blast
description: Deals an initial physical hit, then a delayed 5x5 blast. Lv5 can apply Stun; that Stun lasts 5 seconds on PvP targets instead of 15 seconds.

name: Setsuna
description: Moves behind the target, deals physical damage, and opens Devil as the next combo route. Setsuna gains a temporary critical hit bonus for its own attack. In PvP, the damage rate is reduced to 50%.

name: Bow Mastery
description: Improves minimum ATK and L.HIT while using a valid bow weapon.

name: Archer's Aura
name_jp: Marksman Aura / マークスマンオーラ
description: Increases L.HIT.

name: Focused Arrow
name_jp: Charge Arrow / チャージアロー
description: Consumes 1 arrow, deals damage, knocks the target back 3 cells, and from Lv2 upward may apply 3 seconds of Stiffness to non-player targets.

name: Blaze Arrow
name_jp: Kindle Arrow / キンドルアロー
description: Element: Fire Consumes 1 arrow and deals Fire physical damage.

name: Aqua Arrow
name_jp: Water Arrow / ウォーターアロー
description: Element: Water Consumes 1 arrow and deals Water physical damage.

name: Terra Arrow
name_jp: Earth Arrow / アースアロー
description: Element: Earth Consumes 1 arrow and deals Earth physical damage.

name: Zephyr Arrow
name_jp: Wind Arrow / ウィンドアロー
description: Element: Wind Consumes 1 arrow and deals Wind physical damage.

name: Long Range Strategy
description: Increases L.HIT and ranged avoidance.

name: Bow Delay Cancel
name_jp: ボウディレイキャンセル
description: Removes existing delay cancel effects, then increases ASPD skill percentage.

name: Double Shot
name_jp: Dual Arrow / デュアルアロー
description: Consumes 2 arrows and hits the same target twice.

name: Piercing Arrow
name_jp: Strike Arrow / ストライクアロー
description:
Area: Narrow line, up to 8 path cells

 Requirement: Bow and at least 1 arrow

 Range: 6 Consumes 1 arrow and attacks valid targets along the direct path toward the selected ground cell. The line can check up to 8 path cells; each cell uses a very small one-cell hit check, so it behaves as a narrow line rather than a square AoE.

name: Eagle Eye
description: A long-range attack with fixed 150% damage.

name: Renowned Archer Stance
description: Reduces long-range physical damage falloff by treating the target as closer for distance penalty calculation.

name: Multi Arrow
description: Fires multiple physical arrow hits at one target. Requires a bow and arrows, unless the character is using ranged weapon parts. The number of hits is limited by the arrows currently equipped.

name: Hunting Strategy
description: Increases damage when attacking a target that the character's partner is currently attacking. The bonus also affects the partner's magical damage through the owner's learned skill.

name: Supportive Blaze Arrow
description: Consumes 1 Fire Arrow and deals 100% physical damage to one target. On a successful hit, the target gains Fire DEF +60 for the listed duration. In PvP, the Fire DEF duration is doubled.

name: Go!
description: Orders all current partners to attack the selected target. The target becomes their priority attack target when it is valid.

name: Come Back!
description: Orders all current partners to stop attacking and clear their current attack target.

name: Supportive Aqua Arrow
description: Consumes 1 Water Arrow and deals 100% physical damage to one target. On a successful hit, the target gains Water DEF +60 for the listed duration. In PvP, the Water DEF duration is doubled.

name: Beast Training
description: Improves Animal-type partners owned by the character.

name: Ferocious Bird Training
description: Improves Bird-type partners owned by the character.

name: Supportive Terra Arrow
description: Consumes 1 Earth Arrow and deals 100% physical damage to one target. On a successful hit, the target gains Earth DEF +60 for the listed duration. In PvP, the Earth DEF duration is doubled.

name: Bestial Roar
description: Commands the summoned wolf to growl at enemies in a 5x5 area around its target. Affected enemies gain aggro toward the wolf equal to 15% of their current HP, and each target has a 15% chance to be Stunned for 5 seconds.

name: Shrieking Bird
description: Commands the summoned bird to shriek at enemies in a 5x5 area around its target. Affected enemies lose S.HIT for 30 seconds, and monsters gain aggro toward the bird.

name: Supportive Zephyr Arrow
description: Consumes 1 Wind Arrow and deals 100% physical damage to one target. On a successful hit, the target gains Wind DEF +60 for the listed duration. In PvP, the Wind DEF duration is doubled.

name: Potion Throw
description: Consumes Recovery Arrow and restores HP, MP, and SP to one target. The number of arrows consumed depends on the skill level and is capped by the number of Recovery Arrows available. HP recovery formula: (150 + floor(caster Lv / 3)) x arrows consumed . MP and SP recovery: 8 x arrows consumed .

name: Powerful Draw
description: Prepares the next skill cast for 15 seconds. The next skill the caster begins during this buff has its cast time reduced, then Powerful Draw is consumed.

name: Bestial Wrath
description: Commands the summoned wolf to deal physical damage to enemies in a 3x3 area around its target.

name: Ferocious Threat
description: Commands the summoned bird to rush to the target and deal physical damage.

name: Ray of Light
description: Consumes 1 arrow and deals Holy physical damage to one target.

name: Dark Sliver
description: Consumes 1 arrow and deals Dark physical damage to one target.

name: Archer Spirit
description: When possessing another character, grants possession stat bonuses based on the possession slot. If the host is using a bow or left handbag in the left hand, that slot is treated like right-hand possession.

name: Exploiting Arrow
description: Increases physical damage against targets that currently have an abnormal status while a bow is equipped.

name: Bestial Blessing
description: Commands the summoned wolf to gain DEF and M.DEF for 50 seconds. DEF and M.DEF are percentage values; Additive DEF and Additive M.DEF are flat values.

name: Arrow Storm
description: Consumes 1 arrow and deals physical damage to enemies in a 3x3 area around the target. If the caster has learned Piercing Arrow , Arrow Storm gains an additional damage bonus of 15% + 15% x Piercing Arrow Lv .

name: Arm Cripple
description: Deals physical damage to one target. On a successful damaging hit, it can inflict No Physical, preventing the target from using physical skills; monsters also cannot perform normal attacks while No Physical is active.

name: Arrow Cleave
description: Launches a moving arrow wave from the caster, traveling up to 12 cells. It checks a 1x1 area as it travels, deals physical damage to each valid enemy it catches, knocks each hit target back 2 cells, and stops damaging after the listed hit cap.

name: Rapid Fire
description: Consumes 1 bullet and deals ranged physical damage to one target.

name: Piercing Shot
description: Deals physical damage; can knock the target back; applies Stiffness.

name: Rifle Mastery
description: Improves minimum ATK and L.HIT while using Rifle. Final L.HIT bonus: flat bonus + floor(base L.HIT x scaling rate)

name: Grenade Shot
description: Deals physical damage; area: 3x3.

name: Iron Armor Shot
description: Consumes 1 bullet and fires along a direct path up to 9 cells toward the selected ground point, dealing ranged physical damage to valid enemies touched by the path.

name: Tear Bomb
description: Consumes 1 Grenade and attempts to Stun valid non-boss enemies in a 5x5 area around the target. A stunned target is also forced out of Hiding.

name: Dual Pistol Mastery
name_jp: デュアルハンドガンマスタリー
description: Improves minimum ATK and L.HIT while using Dual gun. Final L.HIT bonus: flat bonus + floor(base L.HIT x scaling rate)

name: Increase Dual Pistol Accuracy
description: Improves L.HIT while using dual guns.

name: Over Range
description: Increases the caster's attack range for 30 seconds.

name: Slow Grenade
description: Consumes 1 Grenade, adds a small amount of aggro to valid enemies in a 5x5 area around the target, and attempts to apply Slow for 6 seconds. A Slowed target is also forced out of Hiding.

name: Stun Shot
description: Deals physical damage; applies Stun.

name: Burst Shot
description: Deals physical damage; applies Hit Melee Down, Hit Ranged Down.

name: CQB
description:
Improves S.HIT and S.AVOID based on base values. Final S.HIT bonus: floor(base S.HIT x scaling rate)

Final S.AVOID bonus: floor(base S.AVOID x scaling rate)

name: Gunmaster
name_jp: ガンディレイキャンセル
description: Removes any existing delay-cancel buff, then increases ASPD for 20 seconds. Higher ASPD shortens normal attack delay and contributes to physical skill cooldown reduction.

name: Bullet Dance
description: Deals physical damage; area: 5x5.

name: Absolute Attack
description: For the duration, the caster's physical attacks are forced to normal hits instead of Miss, Avoid, Guard, or non-forced Critical results. Critical hits that are explicitly forced by the skill still remain Critical.

name: Vital Shot
description: Deals physical damage and may lower S.HIT, L.HIT, S.AVOID, and L.AVOID. Those stat-down effects last 30 seconds in PvP instead of 15 seconds; the Slow duration is unchanged.

name: Scatter Bullet
description: Deals physical damage; area: 7x7.

name: Cross Crest
description: Consumes 5 bullets and deals a heavy ranged physical shot to one target.

name: Shooting Mastery
name_jp: シューティングマスタリー
description: Improves ATK, L.HIT, and critical hit while using a bow, gun, dual gun, or rifle.

name: HIT Communion
target: Party members on the same map
description: Consumes up to 100 of the caster's current SP and converts the spent SP into S.HIT and L.HIT for valid party members on the same map. In PvP, the conversion rate is lower.

name: Hawkeye
description: Temporarily increases the character's outgoing damage. The damage bonus is applied while the buff is active.

name: No Hate
description: Reduces monster aggro generated from the character's damage.

name: Quick Shoot
description: While active, each attack has a chance to add one extra hit. Casting the skill again while it is active removes the buff.

name: Revenge Trigger
description: When a ranged attack misses, is avoided, or is guarded, has a chance to queue one extra hit. The queued hit is forced to be a critical hit.

name: Weakness Shot
name_jp: ウィークネスショット
description: While active, the character's damaging attacks can apply a level-based debuff to non-boss targets. The application chance is 50% normally and 30% in PvP.

name: Flare Shot
description: Consumes one projectile, damages the target, knocks it back 2 cells on a successful hit, then detonates a 3x3 follow-up hit around the target after a short delay. The follow-up can apply Flare for 20 seconds; Flare deals damage every 2 seconds based on the target's Max HP, capped at 300 damage per tick and cannot kill by itself.

name: Tempest Shot
description: Consumes projectiles equal to the skill level and creates a Neutral damage field at the target location. The field deals physical damage every 0.4 seconds. PvP damage is reduced by 50%.

name: Change Target
description: Places a temporary decoy partner at the selected location. Non-boss enemies in the 3x3 area around the decoy receive aggro toward it. Up to 5 decoys can exist at once; placing another removes the oldest one.

name: Search Weak Point
name_jp: サーチウィークポイント
description: Buffs valid allies in a 9x9 area. The caster receives a larger critical hit bonus, while other affected allies receive the regular critical hit bonus. Affected characters also gain an extra ranged hit-check bonus equal to 10% of their base L.HIT.

name: Impact Shot
description: Consumes one projectile and deals 3x3 physical damage with no ranged damage reduction. On successful HP damage, non-boss targets can be Stunned. If the target has Stun Resist, the stun chance is fixed at 10%.

name: Mirage Shot
description: Creates two temporary partner copies beside the character for 6 seconds. Each copy immediately attacks the selected target with Mirage Shot's follow-up attack, then disappears after the follow-up finishes or when its timer expires.

name: Energy Bolt
description: Deals Neutral magical damage to one target.

name: Increase Maximum MP
description: Raises maximum MP. The applied bonus is the higher value between the percentage bonus and the listed minimum bonus.

name: Increase MP Regeneration
description: Increases MP recovery.

name: Magic Creature Knowledge
description: Lets the character obtain special knowledge drops from Magic Creature monsters. When a killed monster matches this type, the game checks that monster's special drop list before its normal drop list. Stealing skills can also use this knowledge to steal from the special drop list when the target is a matching monster.

name: Heat
description: Applies Heat to valid party targets in a 3x3 area around the caster for 30 minutes. Heat, Fireproof Shield, and Aqua Lung overwrite each other.

name: Decoy
description: Summons a decoy at the selected ground cell. A character can keep up to 3 decoys; creating another removes the oldest one.

name: Energy Shock
description: Deals Neutral magical damage to one target.

name: Mystic Silence
description: Attempts to apply Silence. This skill deals no damage.

name: Mystic Poison
description: Attempts to apply Poison. The skill's direct hit deals no damage, but Poison ticks every 2 seconds for 5% of the target's Max HP, cannot reduce HP below 1, and halves the target's ATK while active.

name: Energy Spear
description: Deals Neutral magical damage to one target.

name: Increase Mace Accuracy
description: Increases S.HIT while using a mace-compatible weapon. Final bonus: base bonus + floor(base S.HIT * scaling rate)

name: Fireproof Shield
name_jp: インテンスヒートシールド
description: Applies Fireproof Shield to valid party targets in a 3x3 area around the caster for 30 minutes. Heat, Fireproof Shield, and Aqua Lung overwrite each other.

name: Medusa Eyes
description: Attempts to apply Stone. This skill deals no damage.

name: Energy Shield
description: Raises percentage DEF and additive DEF for 15 minutes.

name: Sword Waltz
description: Deals Neutral magical damage that is checked against the target's DEF.

name: Magic Shield
description: Raises percentage M.DEF and additive M.DEF for 15 minutes.

name: Aqua Lung
description: Applies Aqua Lung to valid party targets in a 3x3 area around the caster for 30 minutes. Heat, Fireproof Shield, and Aqua Lung overwrite each other.

name: Soul Perfection
name_jp: パーフェクションウォール
description: Creates a 5-cell line wall around the targeted position. It blocks movement and knocks nearby actors away; idle non-boss monsters touching it are defeated. Up to 3 wall groups can be maintained; older groups are removed when the limit is exceeded.

name: Energy Blast
description: Attacks enemies in a 3x3 area around the target. Damage is split between valid targets in the area.

name: Magic Ball
description: Sends a moving Neutral magic ball along a narrow line for up to 8 path cells. Each path cell checks a small one-cell area and knocks targets back.

name: Mana Absorption
description: For the duration, single-target offensive skills used by the buffed character can restore MP after they affect a target. The MP restored is based on the skill level and is handled after the attack resolves.

name: Invisibility
description: Makes valid allies in a 3x3 area around the caster transparent for 30 seconds. It cannot be used if an enemy is within the wider 7x7 safety check around the caster.

name: Salvation Aura
description: Blocks a limited number of incoming physical hits on the target. Each blocked hit deals 0 damage and consumes 1 block count. The buff is removed when its block count reaches 0. It cannot be used in Ring Death Match or Knight Training maps, and it removes Dispel Field from the target.

name: Magic Creature Analysis
description: Can only be used on Magic Creature monsters. Marks the monster for 10 seconds, increasing special drop-table checks against that monster. The same Analysis bonus is used by stealing-style skills when they pull from a matching knowledge special drop table.

name: Invisibility Break
name_jp: インビジブルブレイク
description: Creates two detection circles for 30 seconds: one at the selected ground cell and one around the caster. Every 0.15 seconds, each circle removes Reflection from actors inside it. If an actor inside is hiding or invisible, it cancels that hiding effect and has a 25% chance to be Stunned for 5 seconds. A target is only processed again after leaving both circles and re-entering.

name: Staff Crafting
description: Opens the Staff Crafting synthesis interface for the selected skill level.

name: Soul Perfection Break
description: Removes magical walls placed on the ground.

name: Energy Barrier
description: Casts Energy Shield on valid allies in a 5x5 area around the caster. The shield strength uses the caster's learned Energy Shield level, or Lv 1 if Energy Shield is not learned. Reflected targets can reflect the buff back to the caster.

name: Magic Barrier
description: Casts Magic Shield on valid allies in a 5x5 area around the caster. The shield strength uses the caster's learned Magic Shield level, or Lv 1 if Magic Shield is not learned. Reflected targets can reflect the buff back to the caster.

name: Hexagram
description: Places an elemental circle under the caster, marking walkable cells in a 3x3 area. It cannot be placed if another elemental circle is already nearby or if an enemy is within the 3x3 placement area.

name: Sorcerer Spirit
description: When possessing another character, grants possession stat bonuses based on the possession slot. If the host is using a bow or left handbag in the left hand, that slot is treated like right-hand possession.

name: Debilitist
description: Has a 30% chance to weaken the target for the listed duration. Against players, it reduces VIT, STR, and AGI. Against monsters, it reduces ATK, S.HIT, and DEF instead.

name: Clutter
description: Has a 30% chance to weaken the target for the listed duration. Against players, it reduces MAG, INT, and DEX. Against monsters, it reduces MATK and M.DEF instead.

name: Overclock
description: Reduces the target's skill delay for 60 seconds.

name: Teleport
description: Teleports to the selected coordinates. Cannot be reused for a short time after use.

name: Spell Cancel
description: Allows currently casting magic skills to be cancelled.

name: Energy Bomb
description: Deals Neutral magical damage to one target. If the target survives the first hit, a delayed 3x3 Neutral magic explosion triggers around that target 0.5 seconds later.

name: Divine Barrier
description: Buffs valid allies in a 3x3 area with DEF, Additive DEF, M.DEF, and Additive M.DEF. Percentage defense values are shown with % ; additive values are flat. If reflected by a target, the buff is applied back to the caster.

name: Sword Frenzy
description: Deals Neutral magical damage to one target, but calculates the target's defense using DEF instead of M.DEF.

name: Earth Fairys Scroll
name_jp: 土属性スクロール作成
description: Opens the Earth Fairys Scroll synthesis interface for the selected skill level.

name: Water Fairys Scroll
name_jp: 水属性スクロール作成
description: Opens the Water Fairys Scroll synthesis interface for the selected skill level.

name: Wind Fairys Scroll
name_jp: 風属性スクロール作成
description: Opens the Wind Fairys Scroll synthesis interface for the selected skill level.

name: Fire Fairys Scroll
name_jp: 火属性スクロール作成
description: Opens the Fire Fairys Scroll synthesis interface for the selected skill level.

name: Reading Mastery
description: Reduces cast time and cooldown when using scroll items. This reduction does not apply in Knight Training maps.

name: Living Staff
description: Summons a temporary living staff partner at the selected ground cell. Recasting removes the previous living staff before summoning a new one.

name: Knowledge Provision
description: While the caster is possessing another character, shares the caster's Magic Creature Knowledge with the target if the caster has learned it. The shared knowledge enables Magic Creature special drop-table checks, including the same knowledge check used by stealing-style loot skills.

name: Energy Storm
description: Deals Neutral magical damage to enemies in a 5x5 area around the selected ground cell. The spell can be reflected by applicable reflection effects.

name: Increase INT
description: Compares the caster's current INT against the target's current INT. If the caster's INT is higher, the target gains the difference as bonus INT; otherwise the skill misses. The buff can be reflected.

name: Energy Infect
description: Deals Neutral magical damage and, on successful HP damage, attempts to apply Silence, Poison, and Stone. Each status has its own chance. If the caster also knows Mystic Silence, Mystic Poison, or Medusa, the matching status chance gains +5% per level of that skill.

name: Danger Dodge
description: Reduces the chance that the character is chosen as the possession target when an attack penetrates the host's possession slots.

name: Monster Sketch
description: Consumes one Sketch Board and attempts to create a finished Sketch Board for the target monster. The target monster gains a small amount of aggro toward the caster.

name: Magic Ray
name_jp: マジックリベレイション
description: Buffs valid allies in a 3x3 area. While active, the target's magical hit calculation is multiplied by the listed rate.

name: Energy Flare
description: Deals Neutral magical damage and, on successful HP damage, has a 40% chance to apply Flare for 20 seconds. Flare deals damage every 2 seconds based on the target's Max HP, capped at 300 damage per tick and cannot kill by itself.

name: Enchantment Block
name_jp: エンチャントブロック
description: Attempts to remove the target's default buffs, except Communion effects, then applies Enchantment Block. While Enchantment Block is active, new non-ignored additions fail to apply to the target. The skill can be reflected.

name: Reflection
description: Grants one reflection charge for 120 seconds. The next reflectable skill aimed at the target is redirected back to the caster, then the charge is consumed.

name: Doppelganger
description: Creates one temporary partner copy of the caster at the selected location. Recasting removes the previous copy. The copy has full HP/MP/SP, uses scaled base combat stats, and gains more skills at higher levels.

rows: Energy Bolt, Energy Barrier, Energy Flare

name: Luminary Nova
description: Deals Neutral magical damage in a 7x7 area. On successful HP damage, targets can receive Flare for 20 seconds. Flare deals damage every 2 seconds based on the target's Max HP, capped at 300 damage per tick and cannot kill by itself.

name: Last Inquest
description: Creates a non-stacking Neutral magic field at the target's location. The field pulses once per second in a 5x5 area. Monsters hit by the field have a 30% chance per pulse to receive 0.5 seconds of Stiffness.

name: Plus Element
description: Registers Plus Element on the character, or on the riding partner while mounted. Current combat damage calculation has a Plus Element damage slot, but this passive does not currently add a value to that slot by itself.

name: C.SPD Communion
target: Party members on the same map
description: Consumes up to 100 of the caster's current SP and converts the spent SP into C.SPD for valid party members on the same map. In PvP, the conversion rate is lower.

name: Force Master
description: Temporarily raises minimum and maximum M.ATK by 150% of the character's current reference M.ATK. While active, the character's magical damage calculation also reduces the target's M.DEF by the listed amount.

name: Decrease Weapon
description: Temporarily prevents the target's weapon and field attack element from contributing to element calculation. Skills with their own non-Neutral element can still set the attack element.

name: Force Shield
description: After the character takes damage, Force Shield triggers when HP is at or below the listed threshold and no Force Shield buff is already active. It grants DEF, Additive DEF, M.DEF, and Additive M.DEF for a limited duration. Learned Energy Shield improves DEF and Additive DEF; learned Magic Shield improves M.DEF and Additive M.DEF.

name: Decrease Shield
description: Temporarily prevents the target's elemental defense buffs and innate elemental defense from contributing to element calculation.

name: Barrier Shield
description: Toggles a barrier that nullifies magical damage using M.DEF. While active, it drains MP every second and ends when the character has no MP. Casting the skill again while active turns it off.

name: Force Bullet
description: Summons a temporary force bullet partner near the target. Up to 4 force bullets can exist at once; summoning beyond that removes the oldest one. Each bullet repeatedly casts a Neutral magical shot at the target while it remains in range. The shot cannot be reflected and can apply Flare for 20 seconds.

name: Freak Blast
description: Deals Neutral magical damage in a 5x5 area around the target. If the caster has learned Energy Infect , the damage rate gains +70%. On successful HP damage, it attempts to apply Silence, Poison, and Stone. Mystic Silence, Mystic Poison, and Medusa increase the matching status chance by +12% per level normally, or +5% per level in PvP.

name: Advanced Ability
name_jp: アドバンスアビリティー
description: Buffs a valid non-riding target. While active, the target's minimum MATK is raised toward their maximum MATK, making their magic damage range more stable. Final minimum MATK: current Min MATK + floor((current Max MATK - current Min MATK) x rate)

name: Photon Launcher
description: Launches multiple Neutral magical projectiles from cells around the caster toward the selected target. The projectiles use DEF for defense calculation and cannot be reflected.

name: Dispel Field
name_jp: ディスペルフィールド
description: Applies Dispel Field to valid allies in a 5x5 area and removes Salvation Aura from affected targets. While active, Dispel Field nullifies a limited number of incoming M.DEF-based magical hits, then ends.

name: Destruction Glare
name_jp: デストラクショングレアー
description: Deals two waves of Neutral magical damage in a 5x5 area around the target. The second wave lands after 1 second. If the caster has learned Energy Bomb, the first wave gains extra damage. PvP damage is reduced by 50% for both waves.

header: Energy Bomb bonus to first wave

name: Fire Bolt
description: Deals Fire magical damage to one target.

name: Ice Arrow
description: Deals Water magical damage to one target.

name: Earth Tremor
description: Deals Earth magical damage to one target.

name: Thunder Bolt
description: Deals Wind magical damage to one target.

name: Elemental Knowledge
description: Lets the character obtain special knowledge drops from Element monsters. When a killed monster matches this type, the game checks that monster's special drop list before its normal drop list. Stealing skills can also use this knowledge to steal from the special drop list when the target is a matching monster.

name: Weapon Blaze
description: Adds Fire attack element to the target for 50 seconds. If the target already has the matching elemental shield state, this also gains extra elemental attack and defense from that shield level.

name: Weapon Chill
description: Adds Water attack element to the target for 50 seconds. If the target already has the matching elemental shield state, this also gains extra elemental attack and defense from that shield level.

name: Earthen Weapon
description: Adds Earth attack element to the target for 50 seconds. If the target already has the matching elemental shield state, this also gains extra elemental attack and defense from that shield level.

name: Weapon Gale
name_jp: ライトニングウエポン
description: Adds Wind attack element to the target for 50 seconds. If the target already has the matching elemental shield state, this also gains extra elemental attack and defense from that shield level.

name: Fire Shield
description: Adds Fire defense element to the target. If the target already has the matching elemental shield state, it can also add elemental attack.

name: Ice Shield
description: Adds Water defense element to the target. If the target already has the matching elemental shield state, it can also add elemental attack.

name: Elemental Sensing
description: Checks the target's elemental property.

name: Earth Shield
description: Adds Earth defense element to the target. If the target already has the matching elemental shield state, it can also add elemental attack.

name: Wind Shield
description: Adds Wind defense element to the target. If the target already has the matching elemental shield state, it can also add elemental attack.

name: Wall of Stone
description: Creates a stone wall at the target position. Cardinal directions place 3 cells; diagonal directions place 5 cells. Each wall lasts 60 seconds and blocks movement.

name: Wall of Flames
description: Creates a fire wall at the target position. Cardinal directions place 3 cells; diagonal directions place 5 cells. Each cell damages and knocks back enemies in a one-cell area.

name: Fire Blast
description: Attacks enemies in a 3x3 area around the target. Damage is split between valid targets in the area.

name: Lightning Blast
name_jp: ライトニングブラスト
description: Attacks enemies in a 3x3 area around the target. Damage is split between valid targets in the area.

name: Aqua Blast
description: Attacks enemies in a 3x3 area around the target. Damage is split between valid targets in the area.

name: Crag Blast
description: Attacks enemies in a 3x3 area around the target. Damage is split between valid targets in the area.

name: Fairy Prayer
description: Creates a 3x3 elemental circle around the caster for 60 seconds. It strengthens existing map elements on affected cells.

name: Fairy Analysis
description: Can only be used on Element monsters. While active, the target's drop rate is increased. The same Analysis bonus is also checked by stealing-style loot skills.

name: Fire Ball
description: Fires a moving Fire magic projectile toward the selected ground cell. The projectile travels up to 8 cells, damages enemies in a small path area as it moves, and knocks hit targets back.

name: Ice Ball
description: Fires a moving Water magic projectile toward the selected ground cell. The projectile travels up to 8 cells, damages enemies in a small path area as it moves, and knocks hit targets back.

name: Earth Ball
description: Fires a moving Earth magic projectile toward the selected ground cell. The projectile travels up to 8 cells, damages enemies in a small path area as it moves, and knocks hit targets back.

name: Thunder Ball
description: Fires a moving Wind magic projectile toward the selected ground cell. The projectile travels up to 8 cells, damages enemies in a small path area as it moves, and knocks hit targets back.

name: Frosty Gale
description: Attempts to apply Frozen. The chance is increased by the target's Water elemental defense value. Using the skill on a monster adds a small amount of aggro.

name: Fossilize
description: Attempts to apply Stone. The chance is increased by the target's Earth elemental defense value. Using the skill on a monster adds a small amount of aggro.

name: Fiery Tempest
description: Deals Fire magical damage to enemies in a 5x5 area around the selected ground cell. The spell can be reflected by applicable reflection effects.

name: Aqua Geyser
description: Deals Water magical damage to enemies in a 5x5 area around the selected ground cell. The spell can be reflected by applicable reflection effects.

name: Earth Fissure
description: Deals Earth magical damage to enemies in a 5x5 area around the selected ground cell. The spell can be reflected by applicable reflection effects.

name: Havoc Thunder
description: Deals Wind magical damage to enemies in a 5x5 area around the selected ground cell. The spell can be reflected by applicable reflection effects.

name: Zen
description: Increases eligible magical damage while active, but eligible skills cost double MP. Some magic skills are excluded from the damage bonus, including Gatling Blaze, Tsunami, Elemental Quartet, Photon Launcher, and Last Inquest.

name: Elementalist Spirit
description: When possessing another character, grants possession stat bonuses based on the possession slot. If the host is using a bow or left handbag in the left hand, that slot is treated like right-hand possession.

name: Gatling Blaze
description: Summons a temporary fire turret at the caster's position. The turret repeatedly attacks the selected target if it remains within range. Recasting removes the previous turret. The number of shots starts at 3 and increases by the number of learned Fire-element skills, up to 9 total shots.

name: Chain Lightning
name_jp: チェインライトニング
description: Deals Wind magical damage along the path from the caster to the selected ground cell. The damage rate is based on the number of learned Wind-element skills.

name: Fire Contract
description: Raises the Fire elemental attack upper limit and the Fire contract value.

name: Water Contract
description: Raises the Water elemental attack upper limit and the Water contract value.

name: Wind Contract
description: Raises the Wind elemental attack upper limit and the Wind contract value.

name: Earth Contract
description: Raises the Earth elemental attack upper limit and the Earth contract value.

name: Icicle Tempest
name_jp: アイシクルテンペスト
description: Creates a non-stacking Water magic field. The field pulses once per second in a 7x7 area and has a 10% chance per pulse to apply Stiffness for 5 seconds. Aqua Geyser and Havoc Thunder increase the damage rate when learned.

name: Lava Lake
description: Creates a non-stacking Fire magic field. The field pulses in a 7x7 area, has a 15% chance to apply 3 seconds of Stiffness to non-boss targets, and gains +20% damage per learned Fiery Tempest level. Earth Fissure increases the number of pulses.

name: Tsunami
description: Creates a moving Water wave in the caster's facing direction. The wave damages enemies along its path and knocks them back 2 cells. Learned Water-element skill levels increase the damage rate.

rows: +30% at 6-9 total Water skill levels, +60% above 9
+30% at 6-9 total Water skill levels, +60% above 9
+30% at 6-9 total Water skill levels, +60% above 9

name: Elemental Quartet
name_jp: エレメンタルカルテット
description: Creates four moving elemental projectiles: Fire, Wind, Water, and Earth. Each projectile travels from the outer pattern toward the center and can hit up to the skill level times. Damage is calculated separately for each element and can be increased by learned skills of that element.

rows: +20% at 5-15 total element skill levels, +35% above 15
+20% at 5-15 total element skill levels, +35% above 15
+20% at 5-15 total element skill levels, +35% above 15

name: Poison Swamp
description: Creates a 3x3 Earth field that damages non-flying enemies every 0.5 seconds. Requires Earth terrain or an Earth circle at the target cell, and only one Poison Swamp from the caster can exist at a time.

name: Bind
description: Places a 3x3 Earth-based field on a ground cell that has Earth terrain or an Earth circle. Only one Bind field from the caster can exist at a time. Every 0.5 seconds, enemies in the field have a 10% chance to gain small aggro toward the caster and receive Slow for 5 seconds.

name: Acid Mist
description: Creates a 3x3 Earth field that damages non-flying enemies every 0.5 seconds. Requires Earth terrain or an Earth circle at the target cell, and only one Poison Swamp from the caster can exist at a time.

name: Fire Pillar
description: Creates a 1x1 Fire field that damages enemies on the cell every 0.5 seconds. Requires Fire terrain or a Fire circle at the target cell.

name: Earth Up
description: Adds elemental defense of the matching element for 50 + 10 x skill Lv seconds.

name: Water Up
description: Adds elemental defense of the matching element for 50 + 10 x skill Lv seconds.

name: Wind Up
description: Adds elemental defense of the matching element for 50 + 10 x skill Lv seconds.

name: Fire Up
description: Adds elemental defense of the matching element for 50 + 10 x skill Lv seconds.

name: Earth Circle
name_jp: アースパワーサークル
description: Places a 3x3 elemental circle for 5 + 5 x skill Lv seconds. Walkable cells in the circle gain +50 field value for this element while the circle remains.

name: Water Circle
name_jp: ウォーターパワーサークル
description: Places a 3x3 elemental circle for 5 + 5 x skill Lv seconds. Walkable cells in the circle gain +50 field value for this element while the circle remains.

name: Wind Circle
name_jp: ウィンドパワーサークル
description: Places a 3x3 elemental circle for 5 + 5 x skill Lv seconds. Walkable cells in the circle gain +50 field value for this element while the circle remains.

name: Fire Circle
name_jp: ファイアパワーサークル
description: Places a 3x3 elemental circle for 5 + 5 x skill Lv seconds. Walkable cells in the circle gain +50 field value for this element while the circle remains.

name: Earth Aura
description: Increases DEF and Additive DEF. DEF is percentage defense; Additive DEF is flat.

name: Water Aura
description: Increases M.DEF and Additive M.DEF. M.DEF is percentage magic defense; Additive M.DEF is flat.

name: Wind Aura
description: Extends the target player's Delay Cancel effect duration for a limited time.

name: Fire Aura
description: Increases minimum ATK and maximum ATK for the target.

name: Power Enchantment
description: Increases minimum ATK, minimum MATK, DEF, and M.DEF for 180 seconds.

name: Speed Enchantment
name_jp: スピードエンチャント
description: Increases S.AVOID, magic avoid, CSPD, and physical skill delay reduction for 60 seconds.

name: Elemental Shrine
description: Creates a 7x7 field for 7 seconds. Every 1 second it damages enemies inside with a rotating element sequence: Earth, Fire, Water, then Wind.

name: Elemental Addition
name_jp: エレメンタルアディション
description: Copies the caster's current elemental defense buff and elemental weapon buff to valid allies in a 9x9 area. The copied buffs last 30 seconds.

name: Enchant Weapon
name_jp: エンチャントウエポン
description: Buffs the target for 120 seconds. While active, that character's attacks have a 15% chance to inflict an additional status based on Enchant Weapon Lv.

name: Gravity Fall
name_jp: グラヴィティフォール
description: Deals Earth magical damage in a 5x5 area around the selected ground cell. Targets damaged by the hit may be Slowed.

name: Elemental Wrath
description: Deals 4 separate magical hits in a 7x7 area around the selected ground cell: Fire, Water, Wind, and Earth. The listed rate is applied once per element hit. The skill also starts a separate 5 + skill Lv second reuse timer.

name: Delay Out
description: Cancels current delay timers when used. Some effects are excluded.

name: MP Communion
target: Party members on the same map
description: Consumes up to 100 of the caster's current SP and grants Max MP to online party members on the same map, including the caster. The Max MP bonus is based on the actual SP consumed, so casting with less than 100 SP gives a smaller bonus.

name: Astralist
description: Increases the caster's elemental advantage bonus while using non-Neutral elemental attacks. Dark-element attacks receive one quarter of the listed bonus. Cannot be applied while riding.

name: Transbody
description: Prepares a one-time elemental defense reaction. When the caster is hit by Fire, Water, Wind, or Earth damage, this buff is consumed and grants a 10 minute defense buff for that incoming element. If the matching elemental shield skill is learned, its level adds extra defense.

name: Remaining Elements
description: Stores the next Fire, Water, Wind, or Earth attack used by the caster. After that attack hits, the target receives the counter-element defense buff shown below, and Remaining Elements ends. Element Memory does not trigger this effect.

name: Amplify Elements
name_jp: アンプリーエレメント
target: Party members on the same map
description: Buffs online party members on the same map. While active, Fire, Water, Wind, and Earth elemental ATK/DEF each gain the listed value, but only for elements where the character already has a positive value.

name: Mysterious Contract Sword
description: Prevents new elemental weapon enchantments from being applied to the target while active. Existing elemental weapon enchantments on the target are removed when this skill is applied.

name: Elemental Bullet
name_jp: エレメンタルブレット
description: Summons a temporary elemental bullet partner at the caster's position. It attacks the selected target up to 4 times within 750 range, cycling through Fire, Water, Wind, and Earth magic damage. Recasting removes the previous Elemental Bullet partner.

name: Earth Cry
description: Deals magical damage; applies Actor Skill, Damage Over Time, Delete Actor Skill, Stiffness; area: 5x5.

name: Pactio
description: Applies Time Span.

name: Wind Explosion
name_jp: ウィンドエクスプロージョン
description: Deals Wind magical damage to enemies in a 7x7 area around the selected ground point. The damage rate gains +50% per learned level of Chain Lightning and +50% per learned level of Icicle Tempest .

name: Element Memory
description: Creates delayed elemental shots around the caster that travel to the target. The attack element is the caster's current attack element. Fire, Water, Wind, and Earth use the listed base rate; Neutral uses 10%, and Holy/Dark use 20%. If Elemental Bullet is learned, Element Memory gains extra hits and damage rate.

name: Elemental Rain
description: Creates a 7x7 elemental rain field that repeatedly deals Fire, Water, Wind, and Earth magical damage. In PvP, each elemental hit uses 75% of the listed damage rate.

name: Heal
description: Restores HP to the target with Holy healing. Cannot be cast while Blessing Seal or Chaos Seal is active.

name: Holy Bolt
description: Deals Holy magical damage to one target.

name: Cure Sleep
description: Removes Sleep from the target if that status is currently active.

name: Cure Poison
description: Removes Poison from the target if that status is currently active.

name: Undead Knowledge
description: Lets the character obtain special knowledge drops from Undead monsters. When a killed monster matches this type, the game checks that monster's special drop list before its normal drop list. Stealing skills can also use this knowledge to steal from the special drop list when the target is a matching monster.

name: Cure Stun
description: Removes Stun from the target if that status is currently active.

name: Increase Petrification Resistance
description: Grants resistance against Stone.

name: Cure Silence
description: Removes Silence from the target if that status is currently active.

name: Increase Poison Resistance
description: Grants resistance against Poison.

name: Cure Petrification
description: Removes Stone from the target if that status is currently active.

name: Cure Confusion
name_jp: キュアコンフュージョン
description: Removes Confusion from the target if that status is currently active.

name: Increase Stun Resistance
description: Grants resistance against Stun.

name: Increase Slow Resistance
description: Grants resistance against Slow.

name: Increase Silence Resistance
description: Grants resistance against Silence.

name: Increase Confusion Resistance
name_jp: コンフュージョンレジスト
description: Grants resistance against Confusion.

name: Increase Sleep Resistance
description: Grants resistance against Sleep.

name: Cure Slow
description: Removes Slow from the target if that status is currently active.

name: Resurrection
description: Revives a dead player target through the resurrection event. Cannot be used on Ring Death Match maps or while Chaos Seal is active.

name: Holy Shield
description: Adds Holy defense element to the target. If the target already has the matching elemental shield state, it can also add elemental attack.

name: Increase Frozen Resistance
description: Grants resistance against Frozen.

name: Holy Weapon
description: Adds Holy attack element to the target for 50 seconds. If the target already has the matching elemental shield state, this also gains extra elemental attack and defense from that shield level.

name: Cure Frozen
description: Removes Frozen from the target if that status is currently active.

name: Turn Undead
description: Damages undead targets using a Holy-style undead damage formula. It can only be cast on undead targets.

name: Holy Ball
description: Sends a moving Holy magic ball along a narrow line for up to 8 path cells. Each path cell checks a small one-cell area and knocks targets back.

name: Seal
description: Interrupts the target if it is currently casting a physical skill, then applies No Physical for a short duration. If the target is not casting a physical skill, only a small amount of aggro is added. The skill can be reflected.

name: Light Contract
description: Raises the Holy elemental attack upper limit and the Holy contract value.

name: Undead Analysis
description: Can only be used on Undead monsters. While active, the target's drop rate is increased. The same Analysis bonus is also checked by stealing-style loot skills.

name: Blinding Light
description: Places a non-stacking light field. Characters inside the field take a penalty to hit checks.

name: Increase Undead Property Damage
name_jp: アンデッドダメージ上昇
description: Increases physical and magical damage dealt to Undead-type targets.

name: Summon Holy Light
name_jp: ホーリーパワーサークル
description: Creates a non-stacking Holy elemental circle. The circle adds +50 Holy field value to walkable cells in its 3x3 area.

name: Defeat Curse
description: Deals Holy magical damage. On successful HP damage, applies Avoid Magic Down.

name: Warmth
description: Heals valid allies in a 7x7 area around the caster. The heal ignores defense. If Cardinal is active, the heal is stronger.

name: Light Whirl
description: Attempts to reduce the target's critical hit and critical avoid by 50. Adds a small amount of aggro to monsters.

name: Goddess Blessing
description: Heals the target and attempts to remove Stun, Poison, Silence, Confusion, Sleep, Stone, Slow, and Frozen. If the caster knows the matching Cure skill for a status, that status uses the higher cleanse chance. Cannot be used while Chaos Seal is active.

name: Clairvoyance
description: Allows the character to target and interact with transparent or hidden targets that would otherwise be ignored by targeting checks.

name: Holy Feather
description: Buffs valid allies in a 7x7 area. While active, the target gains +15 HP/MP/SP recovery and also receives MP and SP recovery ticks every 5 seconds. Cannot be used while Chaos Seal is active.

name: Magic Seal
description: Interrupts the target if it is currently casting a magical skill, then applies Magic Sealed for a short duration. If the target is not casting a magical skill, only a small amount of aggro is added.

name: Vital Rousing
description: Buffs the target for 180 seconds. Player targets receive VIT, STR, and AGI. Non-player targets instead receive percentage-based ATK, S.AVOID, L.AVOID, and DEF bonuses. The skill can be reflected.

name: Heavenly Blessing
description: Adds Holy elemental defense to the target. The buff lasts 50 + 10 x skill Lv seconds and can be applied to valid allies or enemies.

name: Vates Spirit
description: When possessing another character, grants possession stat bonuses based on the possession slot. If the host is using a bow or left handbag in the left hand, that slot is treated like right-hand possession.

name: Mental Rousing
description: Buffs the target for 180 seconds. Player targets receive DEX, INT, and MAG. Non-player targets instead receive percentage-based MATK, M.DEF, and S.AVOID against magic bonuses. The skill can be reflected.

name: Possession Acceleration
description: Reduces possession cast time. Base possession cast time is 30 seconds before this reduction.

name: Celestial Light
description: Deals Holy magical damage only to Undead enemies in a 7x7 area around the caster. If the caster has Turn Undead, Celestial Light gains additional damage based on Turn Undead Lv.

name: Inspiration
description: Heals valid allies in a 3x3 area around the target point and damages Undead enemies in the same area. The effect ignores defense. If Cardinal is active, Inspiration gains extra healing and Undead damage based on Cardinal Lv.

name: Increase All Resistance
description: Grants resistance flags against Confusion, Frozen, Stun, Poison, Silence, Sleep, Slow, and Stone for the listed duration.

name: Sacred Embrace
name_jp: セイクリッドエンブレイス
description: In a 5x5 area, heals living allies, damages Undead enemies, and prepares eligible dead player characters for revival. Living allies also receive +15 HP/MP/SP recovery for the listed buff duration. Cardinal increases both healing and Undead damage. Cannot be used in Ring Death Match or while Chaos Seal is active.

name: Guerilla Live
description: Requires an airship location.

name: Music Mastery
name_jp: ミュージカルマスタリー
description: Reduces cast time and cooldown for skills that require an instrument.

name: Samba
description: Creates a 5x5 musical field centered on the caster. The field pulses every 0.5 seconds and raises DEF and Additive DEF for valid allies while they remain inside it. Samba can also include possessed actors in its buff checks.

name: Classic
description: Creates a 5x5 musical field centered on the caster. The field raises Max HP, Max MP, and Max SP for valid allies while they remain inside it.

name: Heavy Metal
description: Creates a 5x5 musical field centered on the caster. The field raises S.AVOID and L.AVOID for valid allies while they remain inside it.

name: RocknRoll
description: Creates a 5x5 musical field centered on the caster. The field raises critical hit for valid allies while they remain inside it.

name: Trance
description: Creates a 5x5 musical field centered on the caster. The field raises minimum ATK and maximum ATK for valid allies while they remain inside it.

name: Requiem
description: Creates a 5x5 musical field for 5 seconds. Once per second, it deals Holy magical damage only to Undead enemies inside the field.

name: Fusion
description: Creates a 5x5 musical field centered on the caster. The field raises STR, VIT, and AGI for valid allies while they remain inside it.

name: Pop
description: Creates a 5x5 musical field centered on the caster. The field raises DEX, INT, and MAG for valid allies while they remain inside it.

name: Music Session
description: Creates one non-overlapping 5x5 musical field centered on the caster. The field checks enemies once per second and can apply both Sleep and Confusion for 5 seconds to non-boss targets. Failed checks remove Sleep from the target if Sleep was present.

name: Musical Blow
description: Strikes one target with Neutral magical damage. Partner-cast versions use Lv3 behavior.

name: Shout!
description: Attempts to Stun enemies in a 5x5 area around the caster for 6 seconds. Successful Stun also cancels hiding.

name: Relax
description: Buffs valid allies in a 5x5 area around the caster, increasing HP, MP, and SP recovery by +25 for the listed duration. Cannot be used while Chaos Seal is active.

name: Attract March
description: Attempts to charm a non-boss target into following the caster. Affected player targets become immobile and switch to follow behavior; affected monsters also switch to follow behavior. Reflection and Reflect Shield can send the effect back to the caster.

name: Loud Song
description: Hits enemies in a short directional cone in front of the caster with Neutral magical damage and knocks affected targets back 2 cells. The cone is roughly 2 cells deep, with wider coverage in straight directions than diagonals.

name: Oratorio
description: Buffs valid allies in a 5x5 area around the caster. While active, Oratorio heals HP every 3 seconds. Cannot be used while Chaos Seal is active.

name: Dead March
description: Hits enemies in a 7x7 area around the caster with Neutral magical damage. Damaged non-boss targets separately roll for Stun, Slow, Silence, Confusion, and Sleep; each successful status lasts 4 seconds. Cannot be used while Chaos Seal is active.

name: Defeat
