description: Changes monster aggro; applies Def Down, Def Add Down, Mdef Down, Mdef Add Down.

name: MDEF Communion
description: Consumes up to 100 SP and grants party members Additive M.DEF for 10 minutes. Normal scaling per SP is Lv1 1.56, Lv2 1.92, Lv3 2.28, Lv4 2.64, Lv5 3.00; in PvP the scaling is reduced to Lv1 0.57, Lv2 0.71, Lv3 0.84, Lv4 0.97, Lv5 1.11.

name: Cardinal
description: Temporarily increases the caster's HP recovery multiplier. While active, Salvation and Gospel also receive an extra healing power bonus based on Cardinal level.

name: Cure Undead
description: Removes Reborn, Zombie, or Undead state from the target.

name: Cure All
description: Has a chance to cure certain abnormal statuses on party members on the same map. Statuses with a learned matching Cure skill are cured reliably.

name: Divine Protection
description: Strengthens abnormal status resistance buffs on the character. When a matching resist buff is active, the status chance is reduced by an additional 60 points on top of the resist buff's normal reduction.

rows: Matching resist buffs reduce the status chance by an extra 60 points.

name: Auto Heal
description: When the character takes damage and falls into a trigger HP range, there is a 40% chance to automatically cast Heal on self with no cast time. If the character has learned Heal, Auto Heal uses that Heal level; otherwise it uses a weaker Lv 1 Heal. The passive is inactive while riding a partner.

name: Angel Ring
description: Deals magical damage; area: 5x5.

name: Mystic Shrine
name_jp: ミスティックシャイン
description: Deals magical damage; can knock the target back; area: 9x9, 7x7.

name: Recovery
description: Restores the target's HP by a percentage amount.

name: Divine Breaker
name_jp: ディバインブレーカー
description: Deals Holy magical damage. Against normal non-PvP targets it ignores left-side defense; in PvP and against boss monsters, it uses normal defense calculation instead.

name: Salvation
target: Single target; Lv2 and Lv4 affect 5x5 around the target
description: Heals HP with Holy magic and may remove Stun, Poison, Silence, Confusion, Sleep, Stone, Slow, and Frozen from each affected target. Lv2 and Lv4 affect valid allies in a 5x5 area around the target; other levels affect only the selected target. If Goddess Blessing is learned, Salvation gains extra healing and a higher cleanse chance; Goddess Blessing Lv10 makes the cleanse chance 100%. If the caster has the Cardinal state active, Salvation gains additional healing.

name: Gospel
description: Applies Actor Skill, Max HPUp, Max MPUp, Max SPUp, Min Atk Up; area: 5x5.

name: Black Widow
description: Deals Dark magical damage to one target.

name: Mystic Stun
description: Attempts to apply Stun. This skill deals no damage.

name: Mystic Confusion
name_jp: マジックコンフュージョン
description: Attempts to apply Confusion. This skill deals no damage.

name: Mystic Slow
description: Attempts to apply Slow. This skill deals no damage.

name: Mystic Freeze
description: Attempts to apply Frozen. This skill deals no damage.

name: Chaos Widow
description: Deals Dark magical damage to one target.

name: Dark Shield
description: Adds Dark defense element to the target. If the target already has the matching elemental shield state, it can also add elemental attack.

name: Shadow Blast
description: Attacks enemies in a 3x3 area around the target. Damage is split between valid targets in the area.

name: Dark Ball
description: Sends a moving Dark magic ball along a narrow line for up to 8 path cells. Each path cell checks a small one-cell area and knocks targets back.

name: Soul Steal
description: Deals Dark physical damage and restores MP to the caster based on the damage dealt.

name: Shadow Blade
description: Strikes one target with Dark physical damage.

name: Darkness Contract
description: Raises the character's Dark element contract value and Dark element ATK upper limit. This improves how much Dark element can be built up from Dark-element buffs and effects.

name: Dream Fog
description: Creates a non-stacking 3x3 fog field for 15 seconds. The field checks enemies every second, adds a small amount of aggro to affected monsters, and attempts to apply Sleep for 7 seconds. The field ends early after 15 successful Sleep applications.

name: Curse Aggravation
description: Raises the success rate of the character's abnormal status applications. The bonus is added before the final chance is clamped, and it does not affect Evaporate.

name: Shadow Pentagram
name_jp: ダークパワーサークル
description: Creates a Dark elemental circle on walkable cells in a 3x3 area. Each affected cell gains +50 Dark field element while the circle remains active. It cannot be placed too close to another elemental circle.

name: Metamorphosis
description: Transforms the caster for 300 seconds and temporarily grants form-specific skills. Casting Metamorphosis again while already transformed cancels the transformation. It cannot be used while the caster is being possessed.

rows: Energy Shield, Magic Shield, Mystical Shockwave

name: Engraving
description: Places a Dark mark on a walkable ground cell. The mark can hold nearby enemies with Stiffness while waiting, except PvP targets are immune to the waiting Stiffness. When triggered by Dark Pain , each mark deals Dark magical damage in a 3x3 area and is removed. The caster can keep a limited number of marks based on skill level.

name: Dark Pain
description: Triggers all of the caster's active Engraving marks. Each mark deals Dark magical damage in a 3x3 area around itself, then disappears. Cannot be used unless at least one Engraving mark is active.

name: Fanatic Shadow
description: Adds a small amount of monster aggro and attempts to force the target into Berserk for 30 seconds. Berserk doubles minimum and maximum ATK by adding the target's current ATK values again, but normally makes the target uncontrollable.

name: Dark Mirage
description: Prepares a 5-second blink dodge. If the caster is hit while the buff is active, the hit is negated, the caster blinks back to the selected coordinates, the buff ends, and the skill receives a 9-second cooldown. If the attacker is a monster, that monster is inflicted with Stiffness for 5 seconds.

name: Shadow Void
description: Deals Dark magical damage to enemies in a 5x5 area around the selected ground cell.

name: Shadow Blessing
description: Raises Dark defense on a valid target. It can be used on allies or enemies.

name: Cabalist Spirit
description: When possessing another character, grants possession stat bonuses based on the possession slot. If the host is using a bow or left handbag in the left hand, that slot is treated like right-hand possession.

name: Mires Ire
description: Creates a 3x3 field that checks enemies every second, adds a small amount of monster aggro, and applies Slow for 5 seconds. Boss monsters are immune, and targets already affected by Slow are not reapplied.

name: Medusa Skin
description: While active, attackers that damage the caster with physical attacks may be inflicted with Stone for 5 seconds. Monster attacks use the higher listed chance; other physical attacks use the normal chance.

name: Dark Mages Hell Brand
description: Places three Marking points around the selected coordinates. Cannot be used unless Marking is learned; duration depends on Marking level.

name: Ablation
description: Deals Neutral magical damage, then attempts to apply Stun, Confusion, Slow, Frozen, Silence, Stone, and Poison if the hit deals damage. Each status starts from the base chance shown below. If the caster has learned the matching Mystic status skill, that specific status gains an additional 2% x that Mystic skill level .

name: Dark Blaze
description: Deals Dark magical damage to enemies around the caster.

name: Soul Sacrifice
name_jp: ソウルサクリファイス
description: Consumes the caster's HP to greatly raise ATK, MATK, DEF, and M.DEF for a short time. The buff also applies Unrecoverable, preventing recovery during the effect. When cast while possessing another character, the stat buffs are applied to the possession target, while Unrecoverable also affects the caster.

name: Undead Summon
description: Summons a Mummy. Using the skill again can dismiss the undead summon.

name: Increase Summon HP
description: Increases the maximum HP of monsters created by Undead Summon . The bonus is applied when the summon is created.

name: Increase Summon's Magic
description: Improves the magic stats of monsters created by Undead Summon . The bonus is applied when the summon is created.

name: Increase Summon's Physical
description: Improves the physical attack stats of monsters created by Undead Summon . The summon also receives an ASPD bonus based on the level of Undead Summon used.

name: Necro Heal
description: Restores HP to monsters created by Undead Summon.

name: Soul Burn
description: Deals damage to the target's MP.

name: Spirit Burn
description: Deals damage to the target's SP.

name: Dark Light
description: Places a Dark Light field at the target ground position. The field covers a 7x7 area, reveals hiding actors in the area, removes Reflection from affected actors, and gives nearby monsters aggro toward the caster. While standing inside the field, actors have their final hit chance reduced by 5% per field level. Up to 3 Dark Light fields can exist for the caster; placing another removes the oldest one.

name: Follow Up
description: Increases physical damage dealt to targets that currently have an abnormal status.

name: Black Flare
description: Deals Dark magical damage to one target. If the hit deals damage and the target is not a boss, it can inflict Flare for 20 seconds. Flare deals damage every 2 seconds based on the target's Max HP, capped at 300 damage per tick, and cannot reduce the target below 1 HP by itself.

name: Evaporate
description: Attempts to instantly defeat a non-boss target. Success chance is 10% + 10% x Lv normally, but 5% + 4% x Lv against PvP targets.

name: Summon Shinigami
description: Summons a temporary Shinigami partner for 6 seconds and orders it to use a level-based attack on the selected target. At Lv 1 it appears near the caster; at Lv 2 and above it appears near the target. The summoned partner is removed after its attack finishes or when its duration ends.

rows: Single target, 3 physical hits at 100% each
5x5 Neutral magical attack, 600%, 70% chance to Stun for 3 sec

name: Chaos Gate
description: Creates a Dark magic damage field on the target. The field attacks valid enemies in a 5x5 area every 0.5 seconds after the first 1 second delay. The field cannot be placed on top of another active ground skill in the same area.

name: Mega Dark Blaze
description: Deals Dark magical damage to enemies in an 11x11 area around the caster. Learning Dark Blaze increases the damage rate.

name: MATK Communion
description: Consumes up to 100 SP and grants maximum M.ATK to valid same-map party members. Final bonus is floor(SP consumed x scaling rate) , so the listed bonus assumes the full 100 SP is consumed. In PvP, the skill uses the reduced PvP scaling shown in the table.

name: Soul Taker
description: Toggles a self-buff that increases Dark-element skill damage while active. Casting Soul Taker again while the buff is active cancels it. The bonus is added only when the attack has a positive elemental bonus and the target is not too resistant to Dark: it does not apply against targets with Dark element value 50 or higher, or Holy element value 100 or higher.

name: Increase Possession Damage
name_jp: 被憑依者ダメージ上昇
description: Increases physical damage against player targets that currently have non-partner possessed characters attached. The bonus scales with both skill level and the number of possessed characters on the target.

name: Collapse of Law
name_jp: コラプス・オブ・ロウ
description: Toggles a self-buff that swaps ATK and M.ATK while active. Casting Collapse of Law again while active cancels the buff. Learning this skill also increases Van Spearnia's token damage bonus by the listed amount per token.

name: Infighting Mastery
name_jp: インファイトマスタリー
description: Raises attack, S.HIT, and critical hit while a dagger, mace, or axe is equipped in the right hand. This can stack with the matching weapon mastery passive.

name: Possession Seal
description: Can only affect player targets. While sealed, the target receives no stat bonuses from characters or partners possessing them, and characters currently possessing that sealed host cannot use skills. It does not remove the possession itself; it suppresses the benefits and skill use while the seal lasts.

name: Soul Separation
name_jp: スポレーションソウル
description: Deals Dark magical damage. If the hit deals damage, each listed debuff rolls independently. Against player targets, it can lower STR, DEX, MAG, INT, and AGI. Against monsters, it can lower minimum ATK, maximum ATK, M.DEF, minimum M.ATK, maximum M.ATK, S.HIT, and S.AVOID instead.

name: Abyss
description: Creates a Dark field on the ground. The field repeatedly deals Dark magical damage in a 5x5 area and also pulls non-boss enemies toward the center every 0.15 seconds while active. The field cannot be placed on top of another nearby field skill.

name: Deadly Sickle Dance
description: Deals Dark magical damage to enemies around the caster. Non-player, non-boss targets also have a small chance to be instantly defeated; Knight Training material targets are excluded from the instant-death check.

name: Summon Fenrir
description: Changes behavior by skill level. Lv 1 attempts to instantly defeat a non-boss target and stores that target's level for 5 minutes if it succeeds. The success chance is caster Lv - target Lv + 30% , clamped between 10% and 100%; against player targets, the chance is capped at 45%. Lv 2 consumes the stored Fenrir mark to heal the caster. Lv 3 consumes the stored Fenrir mark to deal unavoidable physical damage in a 5x5 ground area.

rows: Instant defeat attempt on non-boss targets; success stores Fenrir mark for 5 minutes
Restores HP, MP, and SP; stronger when consuming a stored Fenrir mark
Unavoidable physical damage, 1100%-2000% based on the stored target level difference

name: Soul Hunt
description: Performs a physical first hit, then if the target survives, automatically chains into a second hit 1 second later. The second hit is Dark magical damage in a 3x3 area around the target, may apply Flare, and restores HP, MP, and SP to the caster if it hits at least one target.

name: Damnation
description: Deals Dark magical damage in a 7x7 area around the target. The damage rate increases by +50% x Abyss Lv and +50% x Deadly Sickle Dance Lv if those skills are learned. In PvP, the final damage rate after these modifiers is halved.

rows: +50% x Abyss Lv, +50% x Deadly Sickle Dance Lv
+50% x Abyss Lv, +50% x Deadly Sickle Dance Lv
+50% x Abyss Lv, +50% x Deadly Sickle Dance Lv
+50% x Abyss Lv, +50% x Deadly Sickle Dance Lv
+50% x Abyss Lv, +50% x Deadly Sickle Dance Lv

name: Ore Knowledge
description: Enables special drop checks when defeating rock monsters. Matching knowledge lets the monster use its special drop table before falling back to common drops. Stealing-style skills that call the same knowledge check can also use the special drop table when this knowledge matches the target.

name: Item Identification
description: Opens item identification for unidentified items.

name: Bonfire
description: Consumes one Wood Chip and places a bonfire for 60 seconds. Allies in the 5x5 area are healed every 5 seconds.

name: Advanced Metal Refining
description: Opens advanced metal refining synthesis for Miner recipes. Higher levels give access to higher-level recipes and improve the related metal repair kit quality path.

name: Camp
description: Sets up a tent at the selected ground location. Requires a tent item with durability, cannot be used on restricted maps or occupied spots, and creates a tent instance with a level-based visitor limit.

name: Item Refining
description: Opens the item refining menu. From there, the character can choose item refining, card assembly, or slot extension; item refining opens the synthesis interface for this skill level.

name: Iron Fortress
description: Maintains a defensive stance that reduces physical damage after defense calculation. It drains 1 SP every second, ends at 0 SP, and is also removed when the stance is broken by movement or other interrupting actions.

name: Craft Metal Repair Kit
name_jp: 金属製品修理キット作成
description: Opens synthesis for metal repair kits.

name: Increase Maximum Weight
description: Increases maximum weight by a percentage.

name: Mud Sling
description: Attempts to reduce the target's S.HIT and L.HIT. On failure, the skill misses and applies no debuff.

name: Rock Sling
description: Throws a stone at a target, dealing physical damage and having a fixed chance to apply Stiffness.

name: DOGEZA
description: Lowers the target's minimum and maximum ATK. Boss monsters receive a much smaller reduction.

name: Two-Handed Mace Mastery
name_jp: ツーハンドメイスマスタリー
description: Improves minimum ATK while using a two-handed mace-compatible weapon.

name: Stone Crush
description: Deals physical damage and may apply Stiffness for 3 seconds if the hit deals damage. Damage is higher against Rock-type targets; against other targets, the damage rate is 100% at all levels.

name: First Aid
description: Consumes 1 First Aid item and heals the target for a percentage of the target's maximum HP.

name: Weapon Construction
description: Opens the Weapon Construction synthesis interface for the selected skill level.

name: Ore Analysis
description: Applies Analysis to a Rock-type target for 10 seconds. While Analysis is active, special drop-table checks against that target gain an extra bonus based on the skill level.

name: Increase Rock Property Damage
description: Increases physical and magical damage dealt to Rock monsters.

name: Armor Construction
description: Opens the Armor Construction synthesis interface for the selected skill level.

name: Converging Shot
description: Orders nearby partners with the gatling cannon skill to fire at the selected target. The partner must be within 5 cells of the caster and already be attacking that target.

name: Balanced Shot
description: Orders nearby machine-type gatling partners to mark the selected target for 60 seconds. While attacking that marked target, the partner gains extra L.HIT on ranged hit checks. The partner must be within 5 cells of the caster.

name: Flame Worshipper
description: Strengthens Fire-element weapon and shield enchantments received by the character. When a Fire enchantment is applied, this skill adds extra Fire ATK and, from Lv 2 onward, extra Fire DEF.

header: Extra Fire ATK for Fire Weapon
Extra Fire ATK for Fire Shield

name: Spreading Shot
description: Orders nearby partners with the gatling cannon skill to fire at enemies around themselves in a 3x3 area. The partner must be within 5 cells of the caster.

name: Critical Encouragement
name_jp: クリティカルアシスト
description: Can only be used while possessing another character. The possession target's next attack becomes a critical hit, then the buff is consumed. Critical Encouragement cancels Battle Encouragement and Defense Encouragement on the same target.

name: Blade Crusade
description: Buffs a valid target using a compatible weapon and increases maximum ATK by +30.

name: Blacksmith Spirit
description: When possessing another character, grants possession stat bonuses based on the possession slot. If the host is using a bow or left handbag in the left hand, that slot is treated like right-hand possession.

name: Miner Training
description: Requires the caster to know Ore Knowledge. Grants Ore Knowledge to same-map party members within 12 cells, allowing their knowledge checks to apply to Rock monsters for special drop-table eligibility.

name: Blacksmith Instinct
description: Shows a direction arrow toward the nearest living Rock-material object within the search radius.

name: Special Equipment Care
description: Buffs valid party targets in an 11x11 area and prevents their weapon and armor durability from being reduced while active.

name: Increase Reinforcement Chance(STR)
description: Increases the success rate of equipment reinforcement when using Strength Crystal materials.

name: Frantic Efforts
description: Increases maximum payload and capacity by +30 for 180 seconds.

name: Lump Throw
description: Deals physical damage and consumes one lump item based on skill level.

name: Earth Shock
description: Deals physical damage in a 3x3 area around the caster and may apply Stun.

name: Flame Heart
description: Increases the caster's final physical damage while active.

name: Machinery Assembly
description: Opens the Machinery Assembly synthesis interface for the selected skill level.

name: Machinery Repair Kit Craft
description: Opens the Machinery Repair Kit Craft synthesis interface for the selected skill level.

name: Machinery Knowledge
description: Enables special drop checks against machine monsters. Matching knowledge lets the monster use its special drop table before falling back to common drops, and stealing-style skills that use the same check can also pull from the special drop table.

name: Pilot Mastery
name_jp: パイロットマスタリー
description: Allows the character to equip and ride robot-type ride partners.

name: Increase Robot Power Regeneration
description: Passive effect. Increases recovery for Machinist robots.

name: Increase Robot HP
description: Increases the riding robot's maximum HP while the character is riding a robot. Final bonus: floor(robot base Max HP x scaling rate)

name: Monster Counter Missile
description: Fires a robot missile at one target and deals Neutral magical damage. The missile travels toward the target before the hit is resolved.

name: Increase Robot Attack Accuracy
description: Increases the riding robot's S.HIT and L.HIT while the character is riding a robot. Final bonus: floor(robot base hit x scaling rate)

name: Increase Robot Defense
description: Increases the riding robot's Additive DEF and Additive M.DEF while the character is riding a robot. Final bonus: floor(robot base additive defense x scaling rate)

name: Chap
description: Scatters chaff at the target point. Valid enemies in the area gain a small amount of aggro toward the caster and have S.HIT and L.HIT reduced for the duration.

name: Increase Robot Dodge
description: Increases the riding robot's short-range and long-range avoidance while the character is riding a robot. Final bonus: floor(robot base avoidance x scaling rate)

name: Increase Robot Attack Strength
description: Increases the riding robot's ATK and MATK while the character is riding a robot. Final bonus: floor(robot base attack x scaling rate)

name: Self-Destruction
description: Ejects the caster from the robot, consumes robot durability, and turns the robot into a bomb at the caster's position. After 3 seconds, the robot explodes for Neutral physical damage in a 5x5 area, then disappears. The caster is moved a short distance away when the skill is used.

name: Bail Out
description: Teleports a short distance within range while riding a Machinist robot.

name: Overrun
description: Puts the riding robot into Berserk. While active, the robot gains bonus minimum and maximum ATK equal to its current ATK values, but becomes immobile unless a learned Cold Blooded Berserk check prevents the immobility.

rows: +100% current Min ATK and Max ATK
+100% current Min ATK and Max ATK
+100% current Min ATK and Max ATK

name: Missile Volley
description: Launches multiple Neutral magical missiles at random valid enemies around the caster. Each missile chooses a target from the area independently, so one enemy can be hit multiple times.

name: Freezing Laser
description: Deals Neutral magical damage and may inflict Frozen if the hit deals damage.

name: Maintenance
description: Increases the riding robot's sitting HP recovery while the character is riding a robot.

name: ECM
description: Changes monster aggro; applies Confusion; area: 5x5.

name: Fire Radiation
description: Sprays Neutral magical damage in front of the robot. The hit area follows the caster's facing direction, covering a short cone up to 2 cells away.

name: Over Tune
description: Tunes the riding robot for a temporary offensive boost. While active, the robot gains minimum ATK and minimum MATK based on the robot's base minimum ATK. Using the skill also starts a 60 second reuse lock.

name: Spark Ball
description: Creates up to four spark balls around the target in sequence. Each ball strikes once for physical damage and may Stun for 4 seconds. If the original target is already dead when a ball activates, that ball searches a 3x3 area around itself and hits the first valid enemy it finds.

name: Ravage Cannon
description: Fires repeated cannon shots in the selected direction. Each shot cannot miss and hits enemies in a 5-cell line pattern based on the robot's facing direction.

name: Armor Strengthening
description: Allows equipment reinforcement.

name: ATK Communion
description: Consumes up to 100 SP and grants party members maximum ATK for 10 minutes. Normal scaling per SP is Lv1 1.56, Lv2 1.92, Lv3 2.28, Lv4 2.64, Lv5 3.00; in PvP the scaling is reduced to Lv1 0.31, Lv2 0.58, Lv3 0.65, Lv4 0.72, Lv5 0.80.

name: Maestro
description: Strengthens machine-type partners and ride robots by adding a portion of the master's stats to the partner. For normal machine partners, the bonus is based on the master's stats. For ride robots, the robot receives a much larger version of the same stat transfer.

name: Weapon Potential Enhancement
description: Allows latent weapon enhancement.

name: Maneuver Attack
name_jp: マニューバー・アタッカー
description: Greatly increases the riding robot's Min ATK and Max ATK. Only one Maneuver or Maneuver overheat can be active at a time. When the buff ends, the rider receives an overheat debuff that temporarily reduces the robot's Min ATK and Max ATK.

name: Maneuver Defense
name_jp: マニューバー・ディフェンス
description: Greatly increases the riding robot's DEF, M.DEF, Additive DEF, and Additive M.DEF. Only one Maneuver or Maneuver overheat can be active at a time. When the buff ends, the rider receives an overheat debuff that temporarily reduces the same robot defenses.

name: Maneuver Speed
name_jp: マニューバー・スピード
description: Removes delay-cancel effects, then greatly increases the riding robot's ASPD, S.HIT, L.HIT, S.AVOID, and L.AVOID. Only one Maneuver or Maneuver overheat can be active at a time. When the buff ends, the rider receives an overheat debuff that temporarily reduces those robot combat stats.

name: Weapon Enhance
description: Buffs valid allies in a 5x5 area around the target, increasing minimum ATK and maximum ATK for the duration.

name: Rock Fall
description: Deals physical damage; can knock the target back.

name: Bewitching Thorn

name: Plant Healing
description: Commands a nearby living plant partner to cast healing on one target. If the caster has learned Harvest Master , plant healing is increased by an additional 80% per Harvest Master level.

name: Delay Bomb
description: Sets a trap at the caster's position and uses Trap Tool durability. The bomb detonates after a delay, cannot miss, and deals physical damage to enemies in a 3x3 area. Up to 3 traps can be active from the caster; placing another removes the oldest one.

name: Alchemist Spirit
description: When possessing another character, grants possession stat bonuses based on the possession slot. If the host is using a bow or left handbag in the left hand, that slot is treated like right-hand possession.

name: Plant Lesson
description: Requires Plant Knowledge. Grants nearby party members Plant Knowledge for a limited time, allowing special drop-table checks against Plant monsters. If the caster has learned Wood Knowledge, the buff also grants Wood Knowledge for Wood monsters. Party members must be online, on the same map, and within 12 cells.

name: Alchemist Intuition
description: Reveals the direction of nearby plants within a certain area.

name: Increase Reinforcement Chance(MAG)
description: Increases the success rate of equipment reinforcement when using Magic Crystal materials.

name: Chemical Throw
description: Creates a chemical field on the target ground cell. The field lasts 20 seconds, checks enemies in a 3x3 area every second, and attempts to apply the level's status for 10 seconds. Up to 3 chemical fields can exist for the caster; placing another removes the oldest one. The skill requires the listed potion item for the selected level.

The plant's ATK and S.HIT are based on the caster's stats; Harvest Master increases those copied stats by 4% per Harvest Master level. The plant's attack cannot miss and hits enemies in a 3x3 area around the target, then the plant disappears.

name: Armor Flay
name_jp: アーマーキャプチャー
description: Deals a very small physical hit. Against players or riding players, a damaging hit may remove upper-body armor. If another character is possessing the armor slot, that possession is cancelled first.

name: Lock Mastery
name_jp: アンロックマスタリー

description: Raises minimum ATK and S.HIT while a handbag is equipped. Right-hand and left-hand handbags use separate values.

name: Human Knowledge
description: Enables special drop checks against Human monsters. When a Human monster is defeated, matching knowledge allows the monster's special drop table to be checked before common drops. Stealing-style skills that use knowledge checks can also pull from the special drop table when this knowledge matches.

name: Generous Tip
description: Pays an extra fee to randomly increase one of the bodyguard's abilities. Requires 30 gold.

name: Risk Shift
description: Attempts to redirect monsters currently attacking the user toward the selected valid target. On success, each affected monster drops the user's aggro entry and changes its attack command target to the selected target.

name: Escape
description: When a monster's normal attack deals exactly 1 damage and the user's HP is at or below the listed threshold, Escape grants a temporary movement speed boost and reduces S.AVOID by 30. It does not trigger again while the speed boost is already active.

name: Physical Training
name_jp: ウェイトコントロール
description: Converts the character's current carried weight into additional minimum blow ATK while a handbag is equipped in the right hand. Final bonus: floor(current carried weight x 10 / (20 - Physical Training Lv - Handbag Mastery Lv)) .

name: Extra Service Charge
name_jp: アディショナルチャージ
description: Pays an extra fee to activate a bodyguard skill. The triggered skill changes by level. Requires 50 gold.

name: Increase Mercenary Soldiers HP Regeneration
description: Improves HP recovery for owned mercenary partners that match the supported human mercenary types.

name: Instigation
description: Targets a non-boss monster. If the user is already being targeted by another non-boss monster, a successful Instigation removes the user's aggro from that current monster and Confuses it for 15 seconds, making it attack the selected monster. If the redirect condition is not met or the chance fails, the selected monster only gains a small amount of aggro toward the user.

name: Trader Spirit
description: When possessing another character, grants possession stat bonuses based on the possession slot. If the host is using a bow or left handbag in the left hand, that slot is treated like right-hand possession.

name: Networking
description: Flags the character as having merchant connections. This is checked by several NPCs and travel routes, allowing access or reduced restrictions where those NPC scripts accept Networking.

rows: Enables Networking checks for supported NPCs, border guards, travel routes, and related shortcuts.

name: Human Analysis
description: Can only be used on Human monsters. Marks the monster for 10 seconds, increasing special drop-table checks against that monster. The same Analysis bonus is used by stealing-style skills when they pull from a matching knowledge special drop table.

name: Increase Reinforcement Chance(CRI)
name_jp: 強化成功率上昇（クリティカル）
description: Increases the success rate of equipment reinforcement when using Critical Crystal materials.

name: Merchant Summon
description: Starts a merchant summon event at the selected ground cell and briefly locks the user's movement while the event script runs. Cannot be used on healing maps or Knight Training maps.

name: Bag Smash
description: Hits the target multiple times with physical damage. If Handbag Mastery is active, Bag Smash gains additional hits equal to Handbag Mastery Lv and +10% damage rate per Handbag Mastery Lv.

name: Common Mercenary
description: Summons a mercenary partner for 300 seconds at the selected ground cell. Only one Common Mercenary can be active at a time; summoning a new one removes the previous one. The mercenary protects the user, can gain EXP/drop eligibility, matches the user's level, gains the user's Max HP as extra Max HP, and copies the user's ATK, MATK, DEF, M.DEF, S.HIT, L.HIT, S.AVOID, L.AVOID, ASPD, and CSPD.

name: Drop Burst
description: Attempts to mark a monster for 10 minutes. While marked, the monster's rare drop slots receive an extra drop-rate bonus when the server rolls its drop table. The bonus applies to rare slots only, after the first three drop entries.

name: Trick
description: Raises the lower end of physical attack damage by adding a random amount to minimum ATK before damage is calculated. The bonus cannot push minimum ATK above maximum ATK.

name: Random Heal
description: Attempts to heal the target. On failure, the user loses HP instead.

name: Roulette Heal
name_jp: ルーレットヒーリング
description: Randomly selects valid allies in a 13x13 area around the caster and heals them with Holy recovery. Each valid ally has a level-based chance to be selected. Double Up doubles the healing rate, doubles the MP/SP cost paid for this skill, and consumes the Double Up buff.

name: Ladies and Gentlemen
description: Applies Min Atk Down, Max Atk Down.

name: Lucky Seven
description: Places three slot reels on the ground for 30 seconds. Each reel changes when defeated. If all three reels show the same result, Lucky Seven triggers a fixed-damage area attack around the target point and removes the reels.

name: Bad Luck
description: Gives a chance to avoid incoming physical attacks. Lady Luck adds +3% avoidance chance per level when learned.

name: Good or Evil
description: Gambles on a physical attack. On success, it deals the listed damage and Lady Luck adds both success chance and damage. On failure, the user is reduced to 1 HP and has a 50% chance to Stun themself.

name: Card Boomerang
description: Throws a card for physical damage. Double Up doubles the damage rate, doubles the MP/SP cost paid for this skill, and consumes the Double Up buff.

name: Double Up
description: For 60 seconds, empowers the next supported skill: Multi Throw , Random Heal , Roulette Heal , Card Boomerang , or Coin Shot . The empowered skill costs double MP/SP, doubles its damage or recovery rate, and consumes Double Up. Double Up itself starts a 10 second reuse timer.

name: Coin Shot
description: Spends gold to shoot the target for physical damage. The skill cannot be used without enough gold. Double Up doubles the damage rate, doubles the MP/SP cost paid for this skill, and consumes the Double Up buff.

name: Skill Breaker
description: Deals a 100% physical hit. If the attack affects the target, it cancels the target's current skill cast.

name: Trick Dice
description: Rolls dice and activates a random effect based on the result.

name: Arcana Card
description: Consumes 1 Arcana Card and randomly triggers one card result at the selected ground cell. Heart is the fallback result. Jack, Queen, and King chances change by skill level.

rows: Heals the selected target with 400% Holy recovery that ignores defense
Summons an attacking partner for 8 seconds
Summons a short-lived protecting partner that immediately uses a support skill
Summons a protecting partner for 12 seconds that uses its skill every 6 seconds

name: Enigma
description: Triggers an unpredictable effect.

name: Animal Rush
description: Deals three physical hits through the main skill and two automatic follow-up hits. Each hit uses the same damage rate.

name: Dealer's Skill
description: While a card is equipped in the right hand, increases card attack power, L.HIT, and critical hit. Current behavior applies the listed stat bonuses; card-consumption saving and Royal Dealer gold-cost saving are not applied by this passive.

name: CAPA Communion
target: Party members on the same map
description: Consumes up to 100 of the caster's current SP and grants Max Capacity to online party members on the same map, including the caster. The Max Capacity bonus is based on the actual SP consumed, so casting with less than 100 SP gives a smaller bonus.

name: Royal Dealer
description: While active, card attacks are supported by special Royal Dealer effects. With a card equipped, non-critical card attacks that would Miss, Avoid, or Guard become normal hits; card-based damage can also spend gold to add fixed damage at Lv 2+.

name: Damage Marking
description: Marks one enemy to take increased physical and magical damage while the debuff lasts.

name: Spirit Marking
name_jp: スピリットマーキング
description: Marks one target. When that target takes damage and has characters possessing it, the mark may deal the same amount of fixed Neutral damage to those possessing characters.

name: Critical Marking
name_jp: クリティカルマーキング
description: Marks one enemy. While marked, normal hits against that target have a chance to become critical hits.

name: Perfect Riot Hammer
name_jp: パーフェクトライオットスタンプ
description: Prepares the next Riot Hammer . When Riot Hammer is used while this buff is active, the buff is consumed and Riot Hammer cannot miss.

name: Rhetoric
description: Buffs valid allies in a 3x3 area around the caster, increasing maximum MP and SP. Each affected ally also has separate 30% chances to gain Bad Luck and Magic Luck for the same duration; Bad Luck can turn incoming physical damage back toward the attacker, while Magic Luck can avoid incoming magical damage. Lady Luck increases both luck trigger chances.

name: Straight Flush
name_jp: ストレートフラッシュ
description: Starts a chained physical combo. The first hit is followed by Straight Flush 2 after the caster's attack delay if the target survives. At Lv 5, the first hit strikes 3 times before the follow-up.

name: Lady Luck
description: Improves several luck-based skill checks. The bonus is added to the related skill's own chance or effect.

name: Bag Master
description: Improves bag-based combat and carrying stats while a handbag is equipped in the right hand or a backpack is equipped on the back. Bag attacks gain extra damage, and Bag Smash gains extra hits and damage.

name: False Money
description: Deals Neutral magical damage in a 7x7 area and may apply Slow, Silence, Confusion, AGI Down, and DEX Down. Each debuff has a 50% chance normally and 15% chance in PvP.

name: Time is Money
description: Deals physical damage; area: 5x5; PvP: effect is reduced to 50%.

name: Grow Up
description: Increases partner EXP gained by 2%.

name: Belief Proof
description: Opens a partner pose selection and makes the active partner perform the chosen linked motion.

name: Heal Fire
description: Places a healing fire for 60 seconds. Allies in the 5x5 area recover HP every 3 seconds; partners receive a larger heal than players.

name: Reins
description: Unlock-style passive for using supported ride partners. It adds no combat stats by itself.

rows: Unlock/marker passive; no direct combat stat bonus

name: Encouragement
description: Raises the target's minimum and maximum ATK for 60 seconds.

name: High Grow Up
description: Increases partner EXP gained by 3%.

name: Metamorphose
description: Transforms the character into the appearance of their equipped partner. Casting it again while transformed removes the transformation.

name: Lion Power
description: Improves the active partner or supported ride partner's maximum HP, MP, and SP.

name: Acrobat Evasion
name_jp: アクロバットイベイジョン
description: Adds aggro to enemies in a 5x5 area around the partner, making them target the partner.

name: Pet Delay Cancel
name_jp: パートナーディレイキャンセル
description: Applies Delay Cancel to the active partner for 20 seconds, increasing partner attack speed.

name: I'm a Tree
description: Transforms the character into a tree for 60 seconds. The state uses the Hiding buff internally and ends when removed by normal buff-ending behavior.

name: Gathering
description: Consumes 8 selected seed items and plants them around the character. It checks the surrounding 3x3 area and spawns plants on walkable empty cells, excluding the caster's own cell.

name: Weed Killer
description: Damages plant-type enemies around the caster. The attack checks a 3x3 area and only affects valid plant targets.

name: Morg Fuel Storage
description: Unlock-style passive for additional Morg fuel storage. It adds no combat stats by itself.

rows: Unlock/marker passive; no direct combat stat bonus

name: Seed Create
description: Opens the seed creation synthesis interface for this skill level.

name: Log House
description: Sets up a log house at the selected ground location. Requires a Log House item with durability, cannot be used on restricted maps or occupied spots, and creates a log house instance.

name: Garden Meister
description: Unlock-style passive for special results or options during Horticulture Craft. It adds no combat stats by itself.

rows: Unlock/marker passive; no direct combat stat bonus

name: Topiary
description: Unlock-style passive for topiary-related garden features. It adds no combat stats by itself.

rows: Unlock/marker passive; no direct combat stat bonus

name: Gardening
description: Unlock-style passive for growing plants in the airship garden. It adds no combat stats by itself.

rows: Unlock/marker passive; no direct combat stat bonus

name: Weather Control
name_jp: ウェザーコントロール
description: Opens airship weather selection on the airship deck. The available choices are Clear, Rain, and Snow.

name: Heaven Control
name_jp: ヘブンリーコントロール
description: Opens airship sky selection on the airship deck. The available choices are Cloudy, Evening, Night, and Space.

name: Furniture Disassemble
description: The cast is accepted, but the skill handler action is empty, so it does not currently produce a disassembly result or material reward.
